product.name: ProWarm Electric Underfloor Heating Mat Kit 100W - 10m2
product.description:
The Floorwarmers Electric Underfloor Heating Mat Kit 100W offers a versatile solution for various floor coverings, ensuring exceptional reliability and hassle-free installation. Here's what you need to know about this kit:

Key Features:

Versatile Solution: Designed to cater to all types of floor coverings, offering exceptional reliability and hassle-free installation.
Long-lasting Warranty: Each product comes with a generous 25-year warranty, providing peace of mind and ensuring satisfaction.
Thermostat Options: A wide range of thermostats is available to enhance your heating experience, including advanced WiFi thermostats for smart home automation and stylish touchscreen thermostats.
Affordable Quality: Combines affordability with quality, offering excellent value for money and luxury of heated floors at an affordable price point.
Multiple Output Options: Available in 150W and 200W outputs, suitable for both primary heating and supplemental heating purposes.
Kit Includes:

Underfloor Heating Sticky Mat (Two individual mats if kit size is over 12m²)
Floor Primer: High-performance universal priming/sealing agent suitable for various substrates
Roller: High-quality roller for applying floor primer to the subfloor
Adhesive Tape: Assists in holding the mat or cable in position during installation
Digital Thermostat (if selected): Allows adjustment of heat settings for added convenience
Conduit
Specifications:

Cable Type: Twin wire cable 100w/m²
Cable Thickness: 3mm
Mat Width: 500mm
Warranty: 25-year manufacturer warranty
Tested: 100% earth screened
Cold Tail Length: 2m
Certifications: UKCA and CE Approved
Installation Guide:

Divide the floor into rectangles and calculate the area to be heated, covering approximately 90% with the heating mat.
Lay insulation boards over concrete floors to minimize heat loss and ensure quicker warm-up times.
Start laying the mat close to the thermostat, ensuring the loops are equally spaced and attaching the mat to the subfloor using the provided tape.
Install an RCD fused spur to power the thermostatic controller/programmer and the mat system, and lay the temperature probe equidistant between two cable loops.
Lay a thin, self-leveling screed over the mat or trowel flexible tile adhesive directly over the mat before laying floor tiles. Allow the adhesive to cure before switching on the system.
Note: Alternative brands of heating mats may be supplied during stock shortages.

Experience the ultimate warmth and comfort throughout your living space with the Floorwarmers Electric Underfloor Heating Mat Kit 100W.

Conduit

Mat Width: 500mm
Warranty: 25-year manufacturer warranty
Tested: 100% earth screened
Cold Tail Length: 2m
Certifications: UKCA and CE Approved
Installation Guide:

Divide the floor into rectangles and calculate the area to be heated, covering approximately 90% with the heating mat.
Lay insulation boards over concrete floors to minimize heat loss and ensure quicker warm-up times.
Start laying the mat close to the thermostat, ensuring the loops are equally spaced and attaching the mat to the subfloor using the provided tape.
Install an RCD fused spur to power the thermostatic controller/programmer and the mat system, and lay the temperature probe equidistant between two cable loops.
Lay a thin, self-leveling screed over the mat or trowel flexible tile adhesive directly over the mat before laying floor tiles. Allow the adhesive to cure before switching on the system.
Note: Alternative brands of heating mats may be supplied during stock shortages.

product.description:
Elevate your temperature control with the Mains Operated Non Programmable Thermostat. Designed for efficient control of a single heating zone, this digital thermostat offers reliable and straightforward operation without the need for programming.

Key Features:

Mains Operated: Powered directly from the mains, ensuring continuous and reliable operation without the need for batteries.
Single Zone Control: Suitable for controlling one heating zone, providing precise temperature regulation for enhanced comfort.
Rotary Dial: Features a convenient rotary dial for easy temperature adjustments. Simply turn the dial to set your desired temperature.
Delay Start: Program a specific time for the heating to start with the delay start function, ensuring your space is heated to the desired temperature precisely when needed.
TPI (Time Proportional Integral): Ensures accurate and efficient temperature control by adapting the heating output to maintain a consistent temperature.
Setback Mode: Activate the setback mode to temporarily reduce the temperature, saving energy when the space is unoccupied. Ideal for optimizing underfloor heating applications.
On/Off Control: Supports both On and Off control modes, allowing easy switching of the heating system as needed.
User-Friendly Interface: Designed for simplicity and ease of use, ensuring intuitive operation and hassle-free temperature adjustments.
Durable and Reliable: Built with high-quality materials for long-lasting performance and durability.
Underfloor Heating Compatible: Particularly suitable for underfloor heating applications, providing accurate and efficient control for optimal comfort.
Upgrade your temperature control with the Mains Operated Non Programmable Thermostat, offering simplicity, reliability, and precise heating regulation for your space.

product.name: Room Thermostat, Programmable, Recessed, Mains operated
product.description:
Upgrade your heating control with the EPH Recessed Programmable Thermostat. This mains-operated digital thermostat is specifically designed for recessed installation and is suitable for controlling a single heating zone, making it ideal for various applications, particularly underfloor heating.

Key Features:

Programmable Functionality: Set customized heating schedules to suit your daily routines and preferences. This programmable feature provides convenience and energy efficiency by ensuring your home is heated when you need it most.
Optimum Start: The Optimum Start feature calculates the ideal start time to reach your desired temperature at the scheduled time, ensuring your home is comfortably heated while minimizing energy consumption.
TPI Control: Utilizing Thermostatic Proportional Integral (TPI) control mode, the thermostat provides accurate and responsive temperature regulation. It continuously adjusts the heating output based on the difference between the desired temperature and the current room temperature, maintaining a comfortable environment.
On/Off Control: Additionally, the thermostat offers an On/Off control mode, enabling manual setting of the desired temperature and control of the heating system accordingly.
Experience precise temperature control and energy efficiency with the EPH Recessed Programmable Thermostat. Whether you have underfloor heating or other heating applications, this thermostat is designed to optimize your comfort and convenience.

product.name: EPH Wiring Centre 10 Zone
product.description:
The EPH 10 Zone Underfloor Heating Wiring Centre is a state-of-the-art underfloor heating logic strip designed to provide seamless control for 230V wired underfloor heating systems. With its 10-zone capacity and various outputs, it offers a complete solution for efficient and convenient heating management.

Key Features:

10-Zone Capacity: Accommodates up to 10 heating zones, allowing individual control and monitoring of temperature in different areas or rooms.
4-Time Inputs: Features 4-time inputs for setting specific heating schedules for each zone based on daily routines and preferences.
230V Pump Output: Includes a dedicated 230V pump output for optimal circulation of hot water within the underfloor heating system.
Volt-Free Boiler Output: Communicates effectively with the boiler via volt-free boiler output, triggering its operation based on zone heating requirements.

product.name: Salus Controls 16Amp Hard Wired Relay for Electric Underfloor Heating RM-16A
product.description:
The RM-16A relay module offers versatile control for electrical devices, with the ability to enable or disable them as needed. Here are some applications of the RM-16A module in conjunction with other Salus products:

Thermostat Connection with Voltage Relay: Connect the thermostat (e.g., VS30/RT200/ERT20/ERT30/ERT50/VS10) to a gas-fired boiler requiring a free-voltage output NO/COM or NC/COM.
Thermostat Connection with NO/COM Relay: Link the SALUS thermostat with the NO/COM relay (e.g., 091FL) for boiler control needing NC/COM output, typically used in solid fuel boiler controls.
Receiver Connection: Connect a receiver with power requirements exceeding the relay's capacity in a regulator. Ensure the receiver's electricity consumption does not exceed 16A.
Connection of Non-Electro Thermal Actuators: Use with wiring centers (KL06-M/KL08NSB/KL08RF/KL10/KL10RF) to connect devices other than electro thermal actuators. For example, connect a pump or electric heating mat instead of an electro thermal actuator.
The compact size of the RM-16A allows for flexible mounting options, either in a flush-mounting box or where control of a receiver with a maximum load of 16A is required.

product.name: ProWarm Premium 8mm Underfloor Heating Edge Insulation 50m
product.description:
ProWarm Premium 8mm Underfloor Heating Edge Insulation is an essential component designed specifically for screeded floors. It plays a crucial role in ensuring compliance with Building Regulations, minimizing heat loss, and facilitating proper expansion of the flooring system. Here's a breakdown of its features and benefits:

Effective Heat Loss Prevention: Acting as a barrier, the edge insulation reduces heat loss, enhancing the energy efficiency of the underfloor heating system.
Compliance with Building Regulations: Using edge insulation helps meet Building Regulations requirements, ensuring a safe and efficient installation.
Expansion Allowance: The insulation strips allow for the free expansion of the floor screed, preventing issues caused by thermal expansion and contraction.
Easy Installation: With self-adhesive backing, the edge insulation can be easily fitted around walls, columns, steps, and doorways. A staple gun can also be used for secure installation.
Trimming Capability: Surplus insulation above the finished floor screed can be easily trimmed for a clean, professional finish once the screed has cured.
High-Quality Standards: ProWarm Underfloor Heating Edge Insulation is KIWA/KOMO approved, WRAS approved, and manufactured in accordance with BS EN ISO 9002 standards. These certifications ensure strict quality and performance standards are met.
Experience the benefits of ProWarm Underfloor Heating Edge Insulation 50m, including easy installation, compliance with regulations, and reliable performance for optimal heat distribution and efficiency in your underfloor heating system. Follow the provided guidelines for proper installation to enjoy the benefits of a well-insulated and energy-efficient underfloor heating system.

product.name: Plumbright 0.16 Litre Shock Arrestor PV016E
product.description:
This Altecnic 0.16 Litre Shock Arrestor is specially designed to prevent the long term effects of water hammer, across a number of appliances & systems. Those would include Boilers, Sinks and Washing machines. 

The Altecnic Shock Arrestor consists of a Pressure Vessel, divided into two chambers by a flexible rubber membrane or diaphragm. 

A shock arrestor works on a heating system by using a compressible gas separated by a diaphragm to cushion sudden pressure spikes. These spikes in pressure are absorbed from WAter Hammer and thermal expansion, protecting pipes and components from damage and noise. When water suddenly stops, the kinetic energy creates a shockwave which the arrestor absorbs before it travels down pipework, preventing expansion stress

product.name: ProWarm Insulation Boards 6mm - ProFoam
product.description:
ProWarm ProFoam Boards are tailored to provide efficient insulation for our underwood heating and carpet heating mat systems, offering a budget-friendly solution without compromising on performance.

Key Features:

Compatibility with Underwood Heating Systems: Designed to seamlessly integrate with underwood heating systems, ensuring effective heat distribution and cost savings.
Underlay for Wooden Floors: These boards not only insulate but also serve as high-quality underlay for wooden floors, enhancing comfort and durability.
Not Suitable for Under Tile Heating Systems: Please note that ProWarm ProFoam Boards are not suitable for under tile heating systems; they are specifically designed for underwood heating and carpet heating mat systems.
Optimal Dimensions: Each board measures 856mm x 600mm, providing practical sizing for installation. With coverage of 0.51m² per board, a pack of 20 boards can cover 10.27m².
Cost-Effective Underlay: Even if not used with underfloor heating, they are the most cost-effective high-quality underlay for wooden floors in the UK!
Enhance the efficiency and comfort of your underwood heating or carpet heating system with ProWarm ProFoam Insulation Boards. These budget-friendly boards offer insulation and reliable underlay for wooden floors, providing a cost-effective solution without compromising quality.

Specifications:

Material: Expanded Polystyrene Sheet
Thickness: 6mm
Sheet Dimensions: 856mm x 600mm
Foam Density: 32 kg/m³
Thermal Conductivity: 0.034 W/mK
Compression Strength: 10 t/m²
Water Absorption: Less than 0.1 vol%
Impact Sound Insulation: 20 dB
Fire Protection Class: C Euroclass
Installation:

This product is laid staggered in a brick bond style.
If using with underfloor heating, the aluminium heating mat can be laid as shown.
Once the heating is installed and tested, wood floor installation may commence as instructed.

product.name: Ultra Prolevel Ultimate - Single Part Smoothing Underlayment - 20kg
product.description:
UltraTile Pro-Level Ultimate is a cutting-edge solution specifically engineered for use with underfloor heating systems. Its advanced formulation enables it to be applied on virtually any subfloor, including various substrates. This semi-rapid curing product allows floor coverings to be installed on top in as little as 4 hours, facilitating quick project completion. Pro-Level Ultimate is a high-performance, free-flowing single-part smoothing levelling compound, incorporating Ecosphere technology made with 20% recycled material for improved application and reduced environmental impact.

Key Features:

Designed for Underfloor Heating: Tailored to meet the demands of underfloor heating systems, ensuring compatibility and optimal performance in heated environments.
Apply Floor Coverings After 4 Hours: Offers fast curing properties, allowing floor coverings to be applied just 4 hours after application, reducing project timelines.
Suitable for Use Over Old Adhesive Residues: Can be applied over old adhesive residues, providing versatility and saving time on substrate preparation.
Contains 20% Recycled Material: Incorporates Ecosphere technology with 20% recycled material, promoting sustainability and reducing environmental impact.
Excellent Adhesion to Almost All Substrates: Ensures strong adhesion to a wide range of substrates, enhancing reliability and performance in diverse applications.
No Need to Prime (Under Certain Conditions): Eliminates the need for priming under certain conditions, streamlining the application process and saving time and effort.
Specifications:

Screed Classification: CT-C12-F5, indicating its suitability for various flooring applications.
Working Time at 20°C: Provides approximately 45 minutes of working time at 20°C, allowing sufficient time for application and levelling.
Walk-On Hardness Time at 20°C: Achieves walk-on hardness in 2-2.5 hours at 20°C, facilitating continued work progress.
Ready to Receive Floor Coverings: Ready to receive floor coverings in 4 hours with a 3mm application, enabling timely completion of projects.
Compressive Strength (N/mm²): Offers impressive compressive strength, with values of 10 N/mm² at 1 day, 12 N/mm² at 7 days, and 15 N/mm² at 28 days, ensuring durability and long-term performance.
Flexural Strength (N/mm²): Exhibits flexural strength values of 2 N/mm² at 1 day, 3 N/mm² at 7 days, and 5 N/mm² at 28 days, further enhancing its structural integrity.
Coverage:

Applied Thickness: Provides coverage per unit for various thicknesses, ranging from 3mm to 30mm, offering flexibility to meet project requirements.
Cleaning, Storage, and Shelf Life:

Cleaning: Tools should be thoroughly cleaned with water to remove excess material immediately after use, ensuring proper maintenance and longevity.
Storage: Store in a dry place at temperatures between 5°C and 30°C to maintain product integrity and performance.

product.description:
This stylish Softline Concord vertical single panel designer radiator from Stelrad represents a high-performing heating option that is manufactured to meet rigorous industry standards. Conforming fully to BS EN 442, this model provides trade professionals with the assurance of fully certified heat outputs and reliable build quality. Built with a steel thickness of 1.25 mm, the appliance is designed for durability and operates at a maximum working pressure of 4 bar.

With its space-saving vertical orientation, this unit measures 1800mm x 592mm, making it highly suitable for areas where wall space is limited. The unit delivers a heat output of 1136 Watts, ensuring rooms are warmed effectively. This model is part of a comprehensive collection that features a range of 36 sizes, which gives heating installers and specifiers exceptional versatility when planning systems for diverse building projects. Because of its sleek format, this vertical single panel unit allows for great versatility when choosing where to install it in any residential or commercial property, while delivering excellent heat performance.

In terms of logistics and on-site handling, the protective wrapping provides complete safety. The strong, practical outer cover ensures the unit stays in immaculate condition during storage and transport, preserving its finish until the final handover to the client. Installers will appreciate that the clever design of this protective casing allows the radiator to be fully mounted on the wall before the outer film is taken off, which prevents any accidental scuffs, plaster splashes, or paint marks during the final stages of room decoration.

product.name: Hansgrohe Rebris E Single Lever Basin Mixer 240 Coolstart For Wash Bowls Without Waste Set Chrome 72583000
product.description:
Quality that suits your style: the tall Rebris E basin tap with CoolStart function
With its timeless, sleek design, the Rebris E 240 CoolStart basin tap will visibly enhance your bathroom. The sleek shapes and precise finishes create a striking look. Rebris E includes modern designer taps at a fair price. Make your own dream bathroom a reality. The large distance between the spout and wash basin creates space for convenient use (ComfortZone 240) and makes the tap ideal for combining with a wash bowl.
The renowned hansgrohe quality brings the promises of a winning design to life: A high-quality ceramic mixer system controls the water volume and temperature. This keeps working smoothly and reliably even after frequent use. Want to save water and energy? Yes, totally automatically: when the handle is in the centre position, only cold water flows. Hot water will only run if it is turned to the left (CoolStart). The flow rate is limited to max. 5 l/min even at high water pressure (EcoSmart). For a full water jet, the single lever tap enriches the water with air (AirPower). This creates a soft jet that splashes less – meet the beauty of water.
Practical functions for greater convenience
The tap even works well with hard water: The aerator can be removed for cleaning and descaled using a coin. No tools needed. This keeps the tap looking like new.
Additional features

    •  Temperature limitation can be set during installation to protect against water that is too hot
    •  Easy installation: Flexible connection hoses make installation easier (size: G ⅜)
    •  Suitable for continuous flow heaters and therefore versatile use
    •  Guaranteed availability: Spare parts are available for up to 15 years after the range has been discontinued

product.description: Produced in Germany by Hansgrohe, the Zesis M33 single lever kitchen mixer features a chrome finish and ceramic mixing cartridge. product.name: Hansgrohe Vernis Blend 4-Hole Rim Mounted Bath Mixer Chrome 71456000
product.description:
Designed by Hansgrohe, the Vernis Blend rim-mounted 4-hole set comprises a bath filler, hand shower, and flexible hose with a bright chrome finish. At 3 bar pressure, the main filler provides a maximum water flow of 25.3 l/min. The 100 mm hand shower head features XXL Performance technology to supply a maximum flow of 17.9 l/min at 3 bar pressure.

This tap set works alongside continuous flow heaters, and Hansgrohe guarantees replacement parts for 15 years post-discontinuation.

product.name: Inta ZERO35 Zero Anti-Freeze Valve 35mm
product.description: The Inta 35mm Zero Anti-Freeze Valve constructed using high quality materials that is designed to protect heat pump systems that are operating with water. Designed to discharge when the system water temperature drops to 3°C, preventing ice from forming in the heat pump circuit that could cause breakdown or costly damage to the system. The patented Inta Zero Anti-Freeze Valves have been specifically designed to quickly and accurately react to the water temperature in the heat pump circuit and do not need the influence of the ambient temperature to operate. The Inta Zero has been designed and engineered to avoid negative influences from low ambient temperatures by directly positioning the element in the system water flow, permitting accurate system discharge only when its truly needed. A protective ring has been included in the construction to prevent system debris clogging the operation of the valve. Double O-rings and reduced surface friction treatment on the operating member also ensure correct operation and reliability time after time.

This kit is required for installations in England and Wales in buildings above 18 meters. This is to adhere to the new building regulations. (The Building Regulations 2020, Part B - Fire Safety, Volume 1:  Dwellings, 2019 edition incorporating 2020 amendments).

This kit is also required for installations in Scotland in buildings above 11 meters. This is to adhere to the new building standards technical handbook 2020: domestic buildings (April 2021 Addendum).

product.description:
This wall-mounted basin mixer from Ideal Standard offers a sophisticated water control solution for modern bathrooms, combining a striking contemporary aesthetic with premium performance. Designed to be recess-fitted into your wall, this elegant bathroom tap helps to free up valuable space around the vanity basin, creating a cleaner and more minimalist look in your washroom. The stunning silk black finish provides a bold alternative to traditional chrome, making it a perfect choice for high-end residential projects and luxury bathroom refurbishments where visual impact is key.

This particular model features a single lever handle that allows you to control both water flow and temperature with one simple hand movement. The operation is designed to be smooth and precise, ensuring comfortable daily use for all family members. The design is characterised by its soft rounded profiles and gentle curves, bringing a softer organic feel to your basin area while maintaining a clean-lined modern edge.

To ensure a correct and secure installation behind the wall, this tap must be ordered with the separate concealed installation part, which has the code A1313nu. Purchasing this necessary internal component alongside your mixer tap ensures that the fitting process can be completed smoothly. Wall-mounted configurations are ideal for pair-ups with countertop vanity basins, offering flexibility in terms of mounting height so you can customise the splash zone to suit your specific basin depth.

Choosing a product from a trusted manufacturer like Ideal Standard gives you peace of mind regarding quality and durability. This tap is built to meet high manufacturing standards, offering reliable function and water efficiency. The matte quality of the silk black surface is also practical, helping to minimise the visibility of water spots and fingerprints compared to highly polished metallic surfaces, which makes keeping your bathroom clean a much simpler task. Add this stylish black mixer tap to your layout to achieve a truly premium finish in your home.

product.name: Ideal Standard Cerafine O Single Lever Mini Basin Mixer () Silk Black BC722XG
product.description:
This elegant Ideal Standard mini basin mixer tap in a striking silk black finish brings a contemporary touch to any modern bathroom space. With its sleek lines and sophisticated dark coating, this fixture is designed to serve as an eye-catching focal point on your hand wash basin. Crafted by a trusted manufacturer, it represents a premium choice for high-end home upgrades and luxury renovation projects where styling is just as important as functionality. The gorgeous exterior coating not only looks highly sophisticated but also helps to keep your bathroom looking clean and stylish day after day. This product is a superb addition to cloakrooms, en suites, or smaller family bathrooms where space might be limited but design standards remain exceptionally high.

At the heart of this single lever mixer is the Firmaflow ceramic disc cartridge, which is engineered to provide incredibly precise control over water temperature and flow. Utilizing a twenty-eight millimetre ceramic disc cartridge, this mixer ensures that operating the single lever is a smooth and effortless experience for every member of the household. By utilizing this advanced cartridge technology, the tap avoids the annoying leaks and drips that can plague older models, ensuring long-term reliability and superb functionality over years of daily use. This means you can enjoy supreme confidence in your bathroom fittings, knowing that the internal components are built to last and designed to deliver an exceptional user experience every single time you wash your hands.

In addition to its stunning looks and smooth control, this basin mixer prioritises environmental efficiency without compromising on your comfort. It comes pre-fitted with a five litres per minute flow regulator, which carefully manages water consumption to help reduce your utility bills and minimise your household carbon footprint. Despite using less water, the flow remains satisfyingly consistent and effective for everyday tasks. When it comes to fitting the tap, the clever Easyfix system makes the entire installation process incredibly straightforward and quick. This handy system reduces the complexity of mounting the tap, saving time for whoever is fitting it and allowing you to enjoy your newly upgraded wash space much sooner. With this combination of stylish aesthetics, water-saving technology, and straightforward installation, this basin mixer is a truly practical luxury for the modern home.

product.description:
This elegant Ideal Standard shower system offers a complete modern showering solution with its exposed single lever mixer and striking silk black finish. Designed by the esteemed Palomba Serafini Associati, this collection showcases a beautiful design language that combines elongated rectangular shapes with circular elements to bring a playful yet sophisticated aesthetic to your bathroom. The silk black finish is one of three gorgeous contemporary options available in this range, giving your wetroom or enclosure a bold, modern appearance that stands out.

Beyond its striking visual appeal, the unit is packed with practical features. The design incorporates integrated shelving, providing a convenient pair of storage shelves to keep your shampoo, soap, and other daily washing essentials neatly organised and close to hand. Crucially, the construction contains absolutely no lead, chrome, or nickel. Instead, the manufacturer utilises high-quality aluminium that is composed of eighty-four percent recycled material, making it an eco-conscious choice that is also remarkably easy to recycle when it eventually reaches the end of its lifespan.

For a highly satisfying and tailored washing experience, the system comes equipped with a generous 260mm shower head that boasts dual spray functions, allowing you to choose the perfect flow for your mood. This is accompanied by a flexible handspray that also features dual functions, which is perfect for targeted rinsing or cleaning the enclosure.

To ensure your showering experience is always safe and comfortable, the unit features a high-performance PreciTherm cartridge. This advanced technology maintains a perfectly constant water temperature even in rough environments where water pressure fluctuates. For added peace of mind, especially in family homes, there is an optional temperature limiter that can be configured to prevent the water from getting too hot. This combination of beautiful design, practical storage, safety features, and strong environmental credentials makes this an outstanding choice for any modern home.

product.description: Grundfos Unilift AP12 pumps are designed for pumping clean non-aggressive water and drainage- and greywater with particles up to 12mm. The pumps are suitable for temporary as well as permanent free-standing installations. Vertical single-stage submersible centrifugal drainage pumps with a vertical discharge port, designed for free-standing installation in wells pits, and tanks. Grundfos UNILIFT AP12.40.04.A1 1x230V 10m pump is a single-stage, submersible centrifugal pump. The pump can be installed horizontal/vertical and has discharge port with a nominal diameter of 40 mm, and has automatic operation. All Unilift AP12 pumps have a threaded vertical discharge port. The pump is available for automatic as well as manual operation and can be installed in a permanent installation or used as a portable pump. The stainless steel pump sleeve is made in one piece, and equipped with an insulated carrying handle. The suction strainer is clipped on to the pump housing for easy removal when maintenance is required. The strainer prevents the passage of large solids, and ensures a slow flow into the pump. As a result, most impurities are prevented from entering the pump. The stainless steel pump housing is fitted with an internal riser pipe ensuring high efficiency. The riser pipe has a number of holes enabling efficient cooling of the motor during operation. The cable entry is of the socket and plug connection type for quick and easy dismantling. The stainless steel shaft rotates in maintenance-free prelubricated ball bearings. The stainless steel impeller is a semi-open impeller with L-shaped blades and a clearance of 12 mm. The blades are curved backwards to reduce any harmful effect from solid particles and to minimise power consumption. The shaft seal is a combination of a mechanical, bellows shaft seal and a lip seal with 60 ml oil between. Seal faces are made of silicone carbide. The motor is a single-phase asynchronous dry-rotor motor. This single-phase motor incorporates thermal overload protection, and requires no additional motor protection.

product.description:
Indulgent showering and fun with water on a budget: high-quality shower system with thermostatic mixer for the bath tub
The Vernis Blend 200 shower system with thermostatic mixer for the bath tub (1 jet type) combines the hand shower, overhead shower and thermostatic bath mixer in an attractively priced package. The 205 mm overhead shower pampers with an even, luxurious water flow here (XXL Performance). The powerful Rain jet offers an invigorating burst of freshness for the entire body. Yet another advantage: As the shower head can be individually adjusted (angle: +/-15°), hair can be kept dry, if needed. Diverting from the bath filler to the shower head is also highly convenient: One touch of the user-friendly diverter is all it takes for the indulgent showering to begin.
Great lengths for convenience in tried-and-tested hansgrohe quality
The 1.60 m long shower hose allows plenty of room to move. Comfortable, safe and indulgent showering: The high-quality hansgrohe thermostatic bath mixer is reliable at maintaining the set temperature. A safety lock protects against excessively hot water (SafetyStop). Users need to press a button if they want a hotter temperature.
Other features
• Always to hand: The shower head is always neat, tidy and easy to reach with the practical shower support
• Easy care: Limescale can be removed by simply wiping the silicone nozzles on the shower head (QuickClean)
• Dazzling look: The permanent shine of the brilliant, low-maintenance chrome finish impress time and time again
• Guaranteed availability: Spare parts can be purchased up to 15 years after the range has been discontinued

product.description:
The Aqualisa Visage Q concealed smart shower with an adjustable head offers a modern, high-tech bathing experience tailored for gravity-fed plumbing systems.

This digital shower system from Aqualisa introduces smart functionality to your daily routine, letting you operate your shower remotely. By connecting to your home Wifi network, the unit integrates with a mobile application as well as smart home setups like Google Home and Amazon Alexa, meaning you can start your water warming up from the comfort of your bed. For households with more than one smart unit installed, you can conveniently manage multiple showers through a single, easy-to-use phone application.

Safety is at the heart of the design. The system provides dependable thermostatic temperature control, which keeps the water temperature perfectly stable even if other taps in the house are running. You can set an adjustable maximum temperature limit to protect children and vulnerable users from accidental scalding. A clear, integrated LED display on the control panel flashes while the water is warming up and switches to a solid light to signify that your selected heat level has been reached, ensuring you never have to step into an icy or boiling stream.

The package features a premium ninety-millimetre Harmony handset that boasts four distinct spray patterns. Among these settings is an eco-friendly spray option, which helps reduce water consumption by up to twenty-five per cent without compromising on performance. The sliding rail, hose, and shower head setup connects to a tidy wall outlet, while the main digital valve can be tucked away up to seven and a half metres from the bathing area. Through the app, users can easily monitor their water consumption and view estimated running costs.

product.name: Wednesbury Plain Copper Tube Length 22mm x 3m X022L-3
product.description:
Wednesbury Copper Tube is renowned for its exceptional durability and strength, making it the preferred choice for professionals in the plumbing and HVAC industries. Copper Tube is a common product used in the installation of plumbing and heating systems for Domestic Hot & Cold Water, Vented or Unvented Cylinders or Gas installations such as Boilers. Wednesbury Copper tube is manufactued in Great Britain and from high-quality copper to the BS EN 1057 Standard, these tubes are resilient against corrosion and wear, ensuring a long-lasting performance that stands the test of time. Whether for residential, commercial, or industrial applications, Wednesbury Copper Tube is the reliable solution you can trust for all your piping needs.
Designed with the installer in mind, Wednesbury Copper Tube is easy to work with, ensuring a smooth and efficient installation process. The tubes can be easily cut, bent, and joined to fit many applications, reducing installation time and labour costs. Additionally, the lightweight nature and flexibility make them a practical choice for both new constructions and industrial projects.  Choosing Wednesbury Copper Tube is not just a smart decision for performance but also for the environment. Copper is a naturally occurring, recyclable material, and Wednesbury Copper Tube is produced with sustainability in mind. By opting for these eco-friendly Copper Tubes, you contribute to reducing environmental impact and promoting resource conservation, making a responsible choice for the planet. Wednesbury Copper Tube is manufactured to the highest industry standards, ensuring consistent quality and reliability. Each tube undergoes rigorous testing and quality control measures to meet and exceed industry benchmarks. This commitment to excellence guarantees that you receive a product that performs flawlessly in every application. Copper Tube is complete with a 25 Year Manufacturer Guarantee
Made with precision engineering to ensure exact dimensions and a perfect fit every time. This meticulous attention to detail guarantees seamless connections and leak-free performance, which is crucial for the integrity of any piping system. When precision matters, Wednesbury Copper Tube delivers outstanding accuracy and dependability.
Professionals across the plumbing and HVAC industries trust Wednesbury Copper Tube for its reliability and performance. With decades of experience and a reputation for excellence, Wednesbury Copper Tube has become the go-to choice for experts who demand the best. When you choose Wednesbury Copper Tube, you align yourself with a legacy of quality and trust that professionals rely on every day.

product.name: Worcester Bosch Heat Exchanger 8716122564
product.description: The Worcester Bosch Heat Exchanger 8716122564 is a genuine Worcester Bosch spare part with a Worcester Bosch manufacturer's guarantee. The Heat Exchanger is a vital component that facilitates the transfer of heat from the burner to the water within a heating system. product.name: Heatmiser 2 Wire Thermal Actuator Ta230 Control
product.description:
The Heatmiser thermal actuator TA230 is a reliable and efficient 2-wire thermal actuator designed to control individual valves on a manifold system. When prompted by a room thermostat, the thermal actuator opens the valves, enabling precise control of the heating in each room or zone. To seamlessly integrate into your underfloor heating system, the Heatmiser thermal actuator is typically wired into an underfloor heating wiring centre, such as the Heatmiser UH4 or UH8. This enables centralized control and synchronization of the thermal actuators throughout the system, ensuring optimal performance and energy efficiency. For convenient installation, the thermal actuator comes complete with a threaded ring nut M30 x 1.5. Prior to fitting the actuator, the threaded ring nut is securely screwed onto the manifold, providing a sturdy base for attaching the actuator. The actuator easily clips onto the threaded ring nut, streamlining the installation process and saving valuable time. Operating on a 230V power supply, the Heatmiser thermal actuator ensures consistent and reliable performance. With its 2-wire normally closed configuration, the actuator efficiently controls the flow of heating water, allowing for precise temperature regulation and comfort control in each room or zone. The stroke length of the thermal actuator is 3.5mm +/- 0.5, providing the necessary movement to open and close the valves with accuracy and precision. This ensures smooth and responsive operation, allowing for precise adjustment of the heating flow in response to the room thermostat signals. Choose the Heatmiser thermal actuator - 2 Wire for your underfloor heating system and experience efficient, reliable, and customizable control of your heating zones. With its robust construction, convenient installation features, and compatibility with underfloor heating wiring centres, this thermal actuator is a valuable addition to any heating system. Specifications Power 230VAC Consumption 2W IP Protection IP54 Stroke 3.5mm +/- 0.5 Valve Connection Threaded Ring Nut M30 X 1.5 Opening Time Start: 120 seconds
Finish: 180 seconds Weight 127g

product.name: Heatmiser neoKit2 Smart Heating Thermostat & Hub Kit - White
product.description:
The HomeKit-Enabled Heatmiser neoKit 2 includes 1 neoStat, 1 neoStat-hw, and a neoHub (2nd generation), allowing you to take control of your heating and hot water from anywhere.

Heatmiser is proud to be one of the very first heating control manufacturers to support HomeKit, the home automation platform from Apple.

HomeKit support offers:

Siri Voice Control: With HomeKit, you can ask Siri to set your Neo in each room to the desired temperature.
Control from inside iOS 10: HomeKit accessories, including Neo, can be controlled straight from the Control Centre in iOS 10. This means you no longer need to open the Neo app to make a quick temperature adjustment.
Automation Rules: Rules can be set up that can trigger Neo and your other HomeKit accessories. There are many triggers, but it could be when you arrive home, open a window or door, or at sunset.
Scenes: A scene on HomeKit works across all of your HomeKit devices, setting up your Smart Home just got easier. A Movie Time scene could raise your Neo temperature, lock the Doors, and lower the blinds. Now that's smart!
System Features

HomeKit Enabled: The Secure Smart Home platform from Apple.
Geo-Location Facility: Using your mobile phone position, Neo will automatically turn the heating off in your home when the last person has left and back on again when the first person is on their way home.
Apple Watch Compatible: Control your Neo System from your Apple Watch.
IFTTT Compatible: Connecting Heatmiser to your Digital World.
UK/Euro/Australian Adaptor Included
Flexible Programming: Your neoStat can be set up to work in 5/2 day, 7 day, or 24-hour mode. 5/2 is ideal for those with different weekday/weekend schedules. 7-day is great for those with different schedules each day, and 24-hour mode offers the same settings for every day - so perfect for those at home most days.
Comfortable Temperature: 4 Comfort levels per day, so you can, for example, have your home warm when you wake, a little lower while you are out at work, warmer in the evening while you relax, and reduced further throughout the night while you sleep.
Easy Away: Turning your heating off shouldn't be difficult - if it is, you are less likely to do it. The easy Away feature in Neo allows you to switch your home heating off from anywhere. Even in Away mode, we have your home covered providing frost protection in your home.
Convenient Profiles: Re-programming your comfort levels as and when your schedule changes is a thing of the past. A profile is a set of comfort levels that you can activate at any time from the app.
Always Updated: Your neoHub will automatically download feature enhancements and bug fixes, automatically updating all of your neoStats.
Clock Sync: Your neoHub will obtain the time from the internet and will automatically correct your neoStats based on your location.
Open API: The open API allows third-party developers to integrate with the Heatmiser neoHub.

product.name: UltraFloor Prime IT Multi-Surface Primer
product.description:
Prime IT MSP is a versatile, water-based acrylic primer, sealer, and bonding aid suitable for a wide range of substrates, both porous and non-porous.

Key Features:

Moisture Tolerant: Ideal for use on substrates with varying moisture levels, ensuring reliable performance even in challenging conditions.
Enhances Adhesion: Improves bonding between substrates and subsequent materials, promoting strong and durable adhesion.
Reduces Pinholing: Helps minimize the occurrence of pinholes, ensuring a smooth and even surface for subsequent applications.
High Coverage: Covers up to 200m² at a 3:1 dilution ratio, providing excellent value for large-scale projects.
Can Be Used as a Curing Agent: Functions as a curing agent, facilitating the proper curing and bonding of subsequent materials.
Size: Available in a 5-liter container, suitable for both small-scale and large-scale applications.
Calculation Guidelines:
For porous surfaces: Apply one coat at a 3:1 dilution ratio, followed by one coat at a 1:1 dilution ratio.
For non-porous surfaces: Apply one neat coat of MSP.
Prime IT MSP is the ideal solution for stabilizing and consolidating substrate surfaces, enhancing adhesion, and ensuring the success of multi-layer applications. Upgrade your projects with Prime IT MSP for reliable results and superior performance.

product.name: ProWarm Underfloor Heating Floor Probe

Whether you need an additional or replacement floor temperature probe, the ProWarm Floor Probe is the ideal solution. It ensures precise measurement of the floor temperature, allowing your digital thermostat to effectively control and maintain the desired heating levels.

Long Length for Versatile Installation
The ProWarm Floor Probe comes with a generous 3-meter length, providing flexibility in installation. This allows you to position the probe conveniently and accurately in your desired location, ensuring optimal temperature sensing.

Compatibility
The ProWarm Floor Probe is compatible with all of our digital thermostats, ensuring seamless integration and reliable temperature control for your underfloor heating system.

Trustworthy Quality
At ProWarm, we prioritize quality and reliability. Our Floor Probe is manufactured to the highest standards, ensuring durability and long-lasting performance for years to come.

Ultraprime offers a reliable solution for enhancing bond strength and improving water resistance on various building substrates. With its versatility, durability, and ease of use, it is an ideal choice for bonding applications in construction and renovation projects.

product.name: ProWarm ProGrid+ Heating Mat - 1m
product.description:
The ProWarm ProGrid+ Heating Mat represents a cutting-edge solution designed to simplify the installation process of loose electric underfloor heating cables. Bid farewell to cumbersome installations and embrace efficiency and convenience.

Crafted with innovation in mind, the ProGrid+ matting features a unique grid system tailored to effortlessly accommodate the electric heating cable within its grooves. No more wrestling with tape or fixings – the pre-spaced design ensures precise placement, enabling users to achieve their desired heat output per square meter effortlessly.

This critical feature serves as a shield against reflective cracking, a common issue caused by shrinkage cracks, board joints, and lateral movement. With ProGrid+, rest assured that your underfloor heating system will remain resilient and durable over time.

Compatible with various floor coverings, including tiles, these kits offer versatility to suit a range of installation needs. Need guidance on installation methods? Experience the future of underfloor heating installation with ProWarm ProGrid+. Embrace efficiency, reliability, and unmatched convenience.

product.name: GivEnergy PV Protect (Automatic PV Isolator)

cables in your house when the mains is isolated..
It acts as a fireman's switch to isolate DC energy in an
emergency, and it allows emergency services to enter the
property through the roof without risk of electric shock.

from the inverter, ensuring that there are no live DC cables
running through the property. The PV Protect is a
mandatory type of device for those wishing to claim the
SEAI grant in Ireland.

product.name: GivEnergy 5.0kW Singler Phase Hybrid Inverter Generation 3
product.description: The GivEnergy GIV-HY5.0 G3 is a single-phase generation 3 hybrid unit that combines a solar inverter with a battery inverter to process up to 5.0kW of power. Direct connection to solar panels allows this unit to convert photovoltaic generation for immediate property use or divert excess production into storage. Storing surplus power during daylight hours lowers grid exports, while discharging battery power to meet household loads reduces grid imports. Built with a discharge rate reaching 3.6kW, the system supports flexible rate tariffs by charging off-peak and discharging at peak usage times. An integrated network interface features both in-built WiFi and a LAN port for a hard-wired connection. GivEnergy covers this inverter with a 12-year manufacturer warranty supported by a UK team.

product.name: GivEnergy 3.6KW / 13.5kWh All in One Energy Storage
product.description:
Primarily working as an on grid system, the
All in One 3.6 can deliver 3.6kW of peak power into
the home on top of any solar generation.
Complete with a substantial 13.5kWh useable battery pack
that stores excess generation. Featuring a modular design
with 4 removable battery packs, allowing for ease of
handling and installation.

product.name: GivEnergy 3.6kW Singler Phase Hybrid Inverter Generation 3
product.description:
The third generation of the GivEnergy Hybrid
Inverter is a battery and solar inverter in one
unit.It can be coupled directly with solar panels to generate
usable electricity in the property as well as store any excess
energy for later use in a battery. The Hybrid Inverter aims to
minimise export by storing excess energy in the battery
during generation hours. Additionally, it will minimise import
by discharging to meet demand in the property.

product.name: GivEnergy 3.0KW Singler Phase AC Coupled Battery Inverter - GIV-AC3.0
product.description:
GivEnergy designed the GIV-AC3.0 as a 3.0kW single phase AC coupled battery inverter that integrates with grid-tied renewable power sources. This unit operates as an independent storage system or pairs with wind turbines, hydro equipment, and solar panels to capture surplus generation. 

Installers can add the unit to an existing solar PV system without affecting UK government incentive payments. The system optimises split-rate energy tariffs such as Economy 7 by drawing power to top up the battery during low-cost off-peak periods. It releases stored electricity during expensive peak hours, reducing reliance on grid power and lowering electricity bills. GivEnergy supplies this model with a 12 year manufacturer warranty alongside UK based technical support.

product.name: Reliance Water Controls Water Shock Arrestor 12.7mm Xves050000
product.description: Shock arrestors are used to prevent water hammer. Water hammer is caused by shock waves running through the water system which create noise, or in severe cases pipe movement within the system. Reverberations are a series of shock waves in quick succession. The pressure wave in such circumstances can be up to three times greater than the standing pressure. Water hammer occurs when the flow rate is suddenly changed e.g. when a valve is quickly closed quarter turn lever operated taps or solenoid valves are two of the main culprits. Reverberations occur when system components have moving parts which respond to an initial shock wave by trying to open or close. The Reliance Water Controls shock arrestor is a mini expansion vessel which works by absorbing the shock wave from the fitting so that it does not travel through the system and cause noise. The closer the shock arrestor is installed to the fitting the better.

product.name: testo 565i Smart vacuum pump 7 CFM 0564 5652 02.
product.description:
The new testo 565i vacuum pump performs refrigeration system and heat pump evacuations completely automatically. Once the desired vacuum target value is reached, pumping is automatically stopped and a vacuum hold test is initiated at the same time. Foreign gases and moisture can thus be removed safely, and data relating to the system's leak-tightness stored.

The data logging function ensures complete documentation. This allows evacuations to run completely independently - for maximum accuracy and efficiency.

Configuration, monitoring of live readings and sending of the measurement report are all easily controlled via the free testo Smart App. This allows you to remain flexible and saves valuable time.

To ensure perfect interaction between workflows, when the testo 565i is switched on, it automatically establishes a Bluetooth connection to the Testo measuring instruments and also the Smart App. The pump also guarantees maximum safety at all times thanks to its compatibility with A2L and A3 refrigerants.

Maximum convenience is guaranteed by the simple oil change mechanism and the sight glass for quick assessment of the oil level, along with the ergonomic handle.

To ensure high reliability, the built-in non-return valve provides effective protection against loss of vacuum, even in the event of unexpected power failures, and offers an extra layer of safety for uninterrupted operation.

product.name: SPI QuickBungs Radiator Bungs 2 Pack SEL9234
product.description:
The SPI innovative Radiator Bung - the perfect solution for preventing any mess or damage caused by dripping water during radiator maintenance or removal.

Designed to fit snugly into the valve aperture, our Radiator Bung provides a reliable seal to prevent any water leakage from your radiator. Its universal stepped/tapered rubber design and dimensions of 13cm X 3cm X 3cm make it a perfect fit for most standard radiators, with a temperature range of -25°C to +90°C. Suitable for pipe diameters from 5mm up to 22mm, it's versatile enough to fit a wide range of radiators.

Made from high-quality, non-toxic and environmentally friendly materials, our Radiator Bung is completely safe to use in your home. Its green colour makes it easy to spot, so you won't forget to remove it after maintenance or removal.

For the best fitting, simply push and twist our Radiator Bung into place. Its durable and flexible material means it can adapt to different-sized apertures, ensuring a secure fit every time.

However, please note that our Radiator Bung is for use in non-pressurised situations only and should not be used as a permanent solution in any plumbing, heating or gas application.

Not only does our Radiator Bung prevent any water damage to your floors or carpets, but it also saves you time and effort by eliminating the need for any additional cleaning or maintenance. And with its compact and lightweight design, it's easy to store and transport whenever you need it.

Don't let radiator maintenance or removal become a messy and frustrating task. Get our Radiator Bung today and enjoy a hassle-free and stress-free experience every time.

The smart and intuitive customer interface allows for straight forward communication in any language. Smart power options provide the flexibility of non-?mains electric operation, protection from power cuts and rechargeable options for off grid installations. product.name: ProWarm Foil Underfloor Heating Mat (Wood, Vinyl & Carpet) - 2.0 M2
product.description:
Introducing the ProWarm Foil Underfloor Heating Mat - the perfect solution for those seeking a comfortable and efficient way to heat their wooden, vinyl, and carpet floors. This innovative product is designed to provide consistent and controllable warmth throughout any wooden flooring, from engineered boards to laminate and hardwood, as well as for vinyl or carpet floors.

The ProWarm Foil Underfloor Heating Mat is easy to install and is compatible with most types of floating floors, ensuring a quick and hassle-free installation process. It features a high-quality heating foil that provides reliable and even heat distribution throughout any floor.

Backed by an industry-leading lifetime warranty, the ProWarm Foil Underfloor Heating Mat provides peace of mind, ensuring you can enjoy the benefits of underfloor heating for years to come. Upgrade your home's heating system with the ProWarm Wood Underfloor Heating Mat and experience the ultimate in comfort and energy efficiency today.

Installation Requirements
These mats MUST be installed in conjunction with ProFoam or XPS Insulation.
When installing carpet/vinyl flooring, Heat-Pak Dual Overlay must also be used.
Ensure that the carpet and underlay combined tog value does not exceed 2.0. Note that in most cases, when carpet is laid, underfloor heating cannot be used as a primary heat source.
Kit Contents
ProWarm Foil Underfloor Heating Mat: Available in single, double, or triple mat configurations for areas over 12m2.
Digital Thermostat: Take control of your comfort with our range of programmable digital thermostats, each equipped with a floor temperature probe.
Adhesive Tape: Ensures a secure installation, keeping the mat or cable in place for a flawless finish.
Conduit: Adds an extra layer of durability and reliability to your heating system.
Specifications
The ProWarm Foil system is an ultra-thin electric radiant floor heating system primarily for use under laminate, engineered wood, glued hardwood, and other floating floors.
Made with Fluoropolymer insulated heating cables sandwiched between two layers of specially reinforced aluminum foil.
Uniform spacing of the heating elements ensures even heat distribution.
Available in heat outputs of 150 W/m2.
Hot and Cold lead junctions are uniquely designed for foolproof installation.
Meets all test requirements of IEC 60335 and SEMKO certified.
Cost-effective, flexible, and easy to install.
Provides close and uniform spacing of heating cables for higher comfort.
Wide range of heat loads and sizes ensure suitability to all kinds of floorings.

product.name: Danfoss RAS-C2 15mm Angled TRV & Lockshield (Liquid Sensor) with 10mm Push-Fit Elbow 013G6007
product.description:
This angled thermostatic radiator valve set from Danfoss features a liquid-filled sensor and a lockshield to deliver dependable temperature management in domestic and commercial properties. This plumbing package, which carries the manufacturer part number 013G6007, combines a 15mm angled TRV with a lockshield and a 10mm push-fit elbow. This design simplifies the job for professional installers working with compatible 10mm radiator pipework. By utilising the 10mm push-fit connection, engineers can achieve a quick and tool-free installation, which significantly speeds up the fit-out process on site.

The core of the system relies on a liquid-filled sensor actuator. This premium component delivers ultra-precise temperature regulation, responding reliably to minor fluctuations in room temperature. Installers will appreciate the revolver RA-FS flow-selectable valve body. This specialised design allows for flexible installation layouts, giving heating engineers the choice of either horizontal or vertical orientation depending on the pipework configuration in the room.

Additionally, this Danfoss unit incorporates several practical features designed to protect the heating system and facilitate easy maintenance. A built-in frost protection mechanism helps prevent freezing and potential pipe damage during severe cold spells, maintaining system integrity when the property is unoccupied. When it comes to decorating or system maintenance, the positive shut-off feature allows for straightforward valve removal. This means that radiators can be temporarily taken down without the need for complex and time-consuming draining procedures. With these trade-friendly attributes, the package provides a highly practical and reliable choice for modern central heating installations.

product.name: Danfoss RAS-C2 Angled TRV & Lockshield 10mm 013G6006
product.description:
This professional Danfoss radiator valve set offers a complete solution for regulating central heating systems with accuracy and efficiency. Designed specifically to streamline the installation process, this package includes both a thermostatic radiator valve and a matching lockshield component. The integration of a flow-selectable bi-directional valve body ensures that the unit can be mounted horizontally or vertically on either the flow or return pipework. This functional versatility eliminates common issues such as water hammer and reduces the time spent on site determining water flow direction.

Featuring a compact angled design, this ten-millimetre connection set is particularly suited for retrofitting or installing in restricted spaces where larger fittings would prove difficult to position. The physical orientation is angled, allowing for neat pipework connections directly from floors or walls.

The system utilises a highly responsive liquid sensor head which reacts swiftly to changes in ambient temperature. This sensor provides precise modulation of water flow through the radiator, maintaining a comfortable environment while optimizing energy consumption. Installers can offer clients reliable performance with an accurate thermal regulation range spanning from eight to twenty-eight degrees Celsius.

Aesthetically, the components feature a classic RAL 9016 surface finish that integrates neatly into modern domestic heating setups. This combi pack arrives complete with all necessary components in a single box, reducing the need to source separate fittings. By choosing this reliable Danfoss package, heating engineers can deliver a durable, standard-compliant setup that operates quietly and effectively.

This Bristan thermostatic exposed shower valve with riser kit in a stunning chrome finish offers a complete and highly functional upgrade for your bathroom. Designed by the trusted experts at Bristan, this complete package contains everything required for a swift setup, meaning there is no need to purchase extra components separately. These specialized components are designed so that any limescale or daily grime can be wiped away simply by rubbing a finger or a cloth over them, keeping your water flowing perfectly without the need for harsh chemical cleaners.

This smart adjustment capability means you can swap your old unit for this one without having to worry about costly and messy retiling work. product.name: Rothenberger RP30 Hydrostatic Pressure Testing Pump 30 Bars 61130
product.description:
The Rothenberger Pressure Test Pump - RP30 stands out as a dependable and adaptable tool, engineered to provide accurate testing outcomes. Its innovative dual-valve system, known as Twin-Valve, enables self-testing, ensuring the precision and functionality of the device. Additionally, the RP30 offers fine pressure adjustment, allowing for meticulous control throughout testing procedures.

Equipped with a testing hose featuring a steel mesh, the RP30 mitigates reading errors, especially when the hose expands during operation. This feature is pivotal in maintaining accurate and dependable pressure readings, bolstering the reliability of the testing process.

Crafted to endure diverse weather conditions, the RP30 boasts cold-resistant properties. Its steel container is coated with DURAMANT, enhancing durability and shielding against corrosion and wear. This robust construction ensures optimal functionality, even in demanding environments.

Key Features:

Dual-valve system (Twin-Valve) for self-testing and precise pressure adjustment
Testing hose with steel mesh to prevent reading mistakes during expansion
Weather and cold-resistant steel container with DURAMANT coating for durability
With the Rothenberger Pressure Test Pump - RP30, you can confidently obtain reliable and precise testing results across a broad spectrum of applications.

Specifications:

Testing and pressure range, with 20 psi steps (from): 0 psi
Testing and pressure range, with 20 psi steps (up to): 440 psi
Testing and pressure range, with 1 bar steps (from): 0 bar
Testing and pressure range, with 1 bar steps (up to): 30 bar
Connection: R 1/2 Inch
Delivery rate: 16 ml/Hub
Product length: 440 mm
Product height: 240 mm
Product weight: 4.5 kg
Product width: 200 mm
Installation:

Connect the pressure hose to the equipment to be tested with valve V1 opened and valve V2 closed.
Open one or several purge points in the installation. Remove the handle-locking hook and pump liquid until all air has been purged from the system. Close the vent points and then fill the installation operating the pump handle with ample movements.
Keep on pumping until the test pressure has been reached.
Close valve V1.
If the test pressure is exceeded during the pumping operation, slightly open valve V2 until the required pressure is attained. Then close all Valves.
If no leaks are present, no pressure drop should be detected in gauge readings. At test completion, open both valves V1 and V2.

product.name: Stelrad LST I Plus K2 Double Panel Radiator 800mm x 1650mm 145245.
product.description:
This high-performance Stelrad low surface temperature double panel radiator is designed to meet the demanding requirements of commercial heating installations. Measuring 800mm x 1650mm, this K2 double panel model provides a reliable heating solution for a variety of professional applications.

For trade professionals managing large projects, this range offers excellent versatility with a choice of 72 sizes. Across this extensive selection, heat outputs range from 196 W to 2767 W, equivalent to 669 BTU/hr to 9411 BTU/hr, allowing precise specification based on the heat loss calculations of each individual room.

In terms of system compatibility, the radiator is engineered to withstand a working pressure of 10 bar, with an operating pressure of 13.5 bar, making it suitable for high-demand commercial environments. To simplify the planning and design phase of modern developments, Building Information Modelling data is fully supported, with BIM files available for download.

For precise temperature control, the package includes a remote Danfoss RAS-D sensor. This specialized component is engineered for commercial heating setups, which the installer can pre-configure to restrict or permit room temperature adjustments from 5C up to 26C, helping to maintain energy efficiency across the building.

To ensure a clean, professional finish, the radiator comes complete with an appealing flat outer casing panel. For easier installation and greater piping flexibility during first-fix plumbing, the casing is fully reversible, adapting to the specific layout of the pipework on site.

product.name: Nuaire MRXBOXAB-ECO2B Wall mounted MVHR Unit
product.description: Nuaire's MRXBOXAB-ECO2B unit has been designed with automatic 100% bypass as listed on the SAP Product Characteristics Database (PCDB). The units operate by continuously extracting moisture-laden air from ‘wet’ rooms within the property and at the same time drawing in fresh supply air from outside. The heat from the extracted stale air is recovered via a heat exchanger inside the heat recovery unit which becomes tempered then filtered before supplying into the habitable rooms, creating comfortable and well-ventilated homes. The heat exchanger block within these units can recover up to 95% of the normally wasted heat. The two independent fans have full-speed control for background and boost ventilation rates. The unit has a summer bypass function. In warmer months this function automatically activates to ensure the property is being well-ventilated and comfort levels are maintained in the home by continuously drawing in fresh filtered air into the habitable rooms.

product.name: Nuaire Drimaster Loft Mounted Positive Input Ventilation System DRI-ECO-HEAT-HC
product.description: Drimaster-Eco Positive Input Ventilation (PIV) ventilation systems are the most effective method of curing and preventing condensation dampness. Recommended for planned and reactive ventilation servicing, essentially the concept is to introduce fresh, filtered air into the dwelling at a continuous rate, encouraging movement of air from inside to outside. To achieve this, the unit is mounted in the loft space, drawing air through the filters and inputting it, at ceiling level, into the property. An integrated heater tempers airflow should the temperature in the loft space drop below a set point, ensuring ultimate comfort in the home.

The neoStat Pro embodies simplicity with its minimalist design and soft-glow digital display, providing essential temperature information for easy control. By leveraging reverse cooling technology, specifically with air or ground source heat pump systems, the neoStat Pro offers passive room cooling for precise temperature management.* Its precise control is supported by floor and air temperature probes and a built-in humidity sensor.

For energy efficiency, it calculates the dew point and pauses cooling when needed to prevent condensation. This keeps your environment comfortable while conserving energy.

Providing subtle heating and cooling control, the neoStat Pro boosts comfort without sacrificing aesthetics or sustainability. It's an ideal solution for modern, energy-conscious homes.
Features:
Heating Mode
Minimalistic design

product.description: A simple to use at home hard water test kit that comes complete with reagent and handy test tube in handy storage box. The water hard­ness level is measured by adding the reagent one drop at a time to a sample of your tap water until it changes colour. The hard­ness is then calcu­lated by counting the number of drops used. The results can then be used for confirming the hardness of your local tap water, setting up a water soft­ener or water filtra­tion system. Each kit is supplied with enough reagent for multiple tests.

The Pert-Evoh-Pert Pipe is a high-quality and versatile piping solution designed for various heating and plumbing applications. It offers exceptional flexibility, durability, and performance, ensuring reliable and efficient operation in your systems.

Lightweight and Ultra Flexible

The Pert-Evoh-Pert Pipe is specifically engineered to be lightweight and ultra-flexible, making it incredibly easy to handle, bend, and install. Its flexibility allows for hassle-free routing around obstacles and tight corners, reducing installation time and effort.

You can trust its quality and compatibility with other components in your installations.

Oxygen Diffusion Barrier

The pipe features an oxygen diffusion barrier that completely encases the inner layer of PE-RT (Polyethylene of Raised Temperature Resistance). This barrier effectively prevents the entry of oxygen into the heating system through the pipe, safeguarding against corrosion and maintaining the integrity of the system over time.

Durable and Corrosion-Resistant

The Pert-Evoh-Pert Pipe is constructed entirely of plastics, providing a uniform and non-reactive structure. This design ensures its durability, corrosion resistance, and resistance to chemical reactions with metals commonly found in heating and plumbing systems. It offers long-lasting performance and reduces the risk of pipe degradation or failure.

Whether you're working on a residential or commercial project, the Pert-Evoh-Pert Pipe offers reliability, flexibility, and longevity. Its superior characteristics make it an ideal choice for various heating and plumbing applications where durability, performance, and ease of installation are paramount.

product.name: Prowarm 1"M  x 1" F - Ball Valve Pair (Red and Blue) 1300183055
product.description:
The ProWarm Manifold Ball Valve Pair is a dependable and adaptable option for managing the water flow in your heating system. Two 1 inch ball valves are included in this set, each nickel plated for increased durability and corrosion resistance.

The ball valves feature a quarter-turn handle, allowing for quick and effortless control of the water flow. When the handle is parallel to the pipe, the valve is fully open, enabling maximum flow. Conversely, when the handle is perpendicular to the pipe, the valve is fully closed, completely stopping the flow of water.

Installing the Manifold Ball Valve Pair is a straightforward process. Simply connect the valves to the corresponding flow and return pipes of your manifold using the appropriate fittings.

By incorporating ball valves into your heating system, you gain greater control and flexibility. These valves enable you to isolate specific circuits or components, making maintenance and repairs more convenient. They also allow for efficient system flushing and balancing, ensuring optimal performance and energy efficiency.

Whether you're installing a new heating system or upgrading an existing one, the Manifold Ball Valve Pair is a reliable choice. Experience the convenience, versatility, and peace of mind that comes with having full control over your heating system's water flow.

product.name: Glow-Worm 801621 Heat Exchanger
product.description:
There are two kinds of heat exchanger that can be installed, the primary heat exchanger and the secondary heat exchanger. The primary is present in almost all boilers and it allows the heat to be transferred from the burner to the water within the system. The secondary heat exchanger is exclusive to combination boilers and allows the heat to be transferred between one closed system and another.

This part is present in 17 different boilers in the Glowworm range including the Glowworm HXI 12 , HXI 15 , HXI 18 , SXI 18 , CXI 24secondary heat exchanger is only present in combination boilers and allows the heat to be transferred between two closed systems. The Primary Heat exchanger is sometimes known as the heat engine or "main" heat exchanger. The secondary heat exchanger  can also be known as the plate heat exchanger or the domestic hot water heat exchanger .

product.name: Glow-worm Secondary Heat Exchanger Insulation Left Hand S210231
product.description: This part is located within the heat exchanger section. There are two different types of heat exchanger that can be present, the primary heat exchanger and the secondary heat exchanger. The primary is present in almost all boilers and it allows the heat to be transferred from the burner to the water within the system. The secondary heat exchanger only appears on combination boilers and allows the heat to be transferred between two closed systems. The Primary Heat exchanger is also known as a "main" heat exchanger or heat engine. The secondary heat exchanger can also be known as the domestic hot water heat exchanger or the plate heat exchanger .

product.description: This part has now been discontinued however you can still purchase the  genuine unbranded alternative part, UCP Automatic Air Vent 0020014161 (443595). The Glowworm Automatic Air Vent 0020014161 is a genuine Glowworm spare part with a Glowworm manufacturer's guarantee. An Automatic Air Vent (AAV) is a pressure safety measure for the central heating unit. They work by using a float to release built-up air. As water flows through the heating and cooling system, a float within the automatic air vent opens or closes depending on the water level. If the system contains no air, the float will be pushed to the top and the vent will be closed until the water level drops.

product.name: Wilo Isar Modh1-3Ch1-L-1002/SCe 29993589
product.description:
Compact pressure boosting system according to DIN 1988 and DIN EN 806, for indirect connection. Consisting of non self-priming, switched in parallel, horizontal stainless steel high-pressure multistage centrifugal pumps. Ready for connection with stainless steel pipework, mounted on a base frame, including control device with all necessary measurement and adjustment equipment.

For fully automatic water supply and pressure boosting in residential, commercial and public buildings, hotels, hospitals, department stores and for industrial systems.

For pumping drinking water, process water, cooling water or other service water, which does not affect the materials used, neither chemically nor mechanically, and does not contain any abrasive or long-fibre constituents. The ISAR booster is fully compliant to The Water Supply (Water Fittings) Regulations 1999 (Regulation 4) and is suitable for safe drinking water applications

product.name: Worcester Bosch HVO Conversion Kit 18/25 18kW (DM) 7731600279
product.description:
We offer HVO conversion kits suitable for our entire oil boiler range manufactured after September 2018. These new kits enable our oil boilers to be safely and efficiently converted to operate on HVO.

All of our oil boilers were tested on HVO to find the correct combination of burner components and settings to match the performance on kerosene. Our HVO kits contain labels for the appliance, burner and oil tank, with updated information regarding HVO. Typically, the kits contain a nozzle, flame sensor and replacement oil valve. Some of our conversion kits contain additional components such as an air damper disc or burner recirculation tube, depending on boiler model and output, in order for each variation of appliance to perform as efficiently as possible.​

product.name: Polypipe Polyplumb Spigot Reducer 22x15mm PB822
product.description:
The Polyplumb Enhanced 22x15mm PB822 spigot reducer creates a permanent push-fit connection between polybutylene or copper pipework. Designed by Polypipe, this non-demountable fitting operates in hot and cold water supply runs, central heating lines and underfloor heating systems. 

An internal In-Cert mechanism gives tactile feedback as soon as the stainless steel grab ring secures the pipe. Tested to British Standard Class S under BS7291 Part 1, the component holds Kitemark licence number 38148 across BS7291 Parts 1 and 19. Full compliance with REG 4 of The Water Supply (Water Fitting) Regulations 1999 certifies the fitting for drinking water systems. 

Available in grey and white plastic finishes, this reducer steps down 22mm runs directly into 15mm pipework. A 50-year warranty provides peace of mind because the joint remains permanently sealed without requiring maintenance.
