Treat yourself to generous, sustainable showering pleasure – with the economical hansgrohe premium hand shower with 4 spray types!
Eco-friendly showering comfort with 4 different spray types
The hansgrohe Croma 100 Vario hand shower offers tremendous showering comfort. Four different spray types bubble forth from its 100 mm shower head – for varied showering to suit the mood and type. The Rain shower starts the day with a boost of freshness. The pleasant normal spray is perfect for any time. The shampoo spray thoroughly rinses all traces of shampoo out of the hair. And the pulsing massage spray releases tension in the neck and shoulder area.
The modern shower is round and flat. The chrome in the handle and shower head in combination with the light grey spray face goes perfectly with any mixer and tile design. The ergonomic handle fits lightly in the hand. The water channel on the inside ensures that the shower head does not get hot. It is also suitable for continuous water heaters.
hansgrohe mixers and EcoSmart showers consume up to 50 percent less water than other products. The technology with the integrated flow rate limiter also saves energy, since less water needs to be heated.
Limescale and residues rub away just like that: Limescale deposits are simply removed from this hansgrohe shower by rubbing over the flexible silicone nubs (QuickClean). Also hygienic: the rinse-off dirt strainer.

product.name: hansgrohe ShowerSelect Comfort Q Thermostatic Shower Mixer Valve, 2 Outlets, Brushed Black Chrome 15583340
product.description:
Design highlight for the bathroom: ShowerSelect Comfort Q thermostatic mixer (concealed installation) for two outlets
The ShowerSelect Comfort Q concealed thermostat from hansgrohe enhances the bathroom in style. The ultra-flat design offers more space in the shower or bath tub thanks to the minimal installation height. An elegant shadow gap makes the thermostatic mixer seem to float weightlessly in front of the wall.
The ease of use is just as impressive as the design: the upper and lower halves of the thermostatic mixer serve as large buttons that turn the water on and off (Select). Simultaneous use of both outlets (e.g. overhead and hand shower) is also possible. The amount of water can be adjusted individually via the slim lower handle. The thermostatic mixer always keeps the desired temperature constant and adjusts automatically if necessary.

product.name: hansgrohe FixFit Q Wall Outlet with Shower Handset Holder, Chrome 26887000
product.description:
Practical can be so beautiful: hansgrohe FixFit Q wall connection with shower head holder
The FixFit Q wall connection with shower support from hansgrohe provides a water connection and a secure hold for the shower head. This looks beautiful and also creates more space in the shower with its compact dimensions. Water volume and temperature can be adjusted via a concealed tap, sold separately. With the wall flange in the elegantly rounded SoftCube design, the hansgrohe FixFit Q wall connection is your number one choice in any bathroom environment – contemporary or classic.
Installation is extremely simple: the FixFit Q is screwed onto an existing water outlet on the wall (size G ½; DN15). After that, any commercially available shower hose can be connected. All hoses with a conical nut will fit into the holder – including shower hoses from the hansgrohe range that are identical in colour also. You can create your own dream bathroom without much effort.

product.name: hansgrohe FixFit Wall Outlet E without Non-Return Valve, Polished Gold Optic 27454990
product.description:
High-quality wall connection in gold look for a shower hose
The FixFit E wall connection from hansgrohe connects the shower hose to a standard water outlet. The version offered here comes without a backflow preventer. For installation where the shower head can be located below the water inlet (e.g. on the bathtub), the FixFit E wall connection is also available with a backflow preventer (#27458990).
Exclusive surface for customised bathroom design
The polished gold-look surface creates an expressive accent and goes well with a luxurious bathroom design. Together with other hansgrohe products in the same colour, it makes your personal dream bathroom possible.

product.name: hansgrohe Raindance S Thermostatic Shower Mixer Set 240, Chrome 27115000

Treat yourself to more showering pleasure – with a safe comfort shower system with 2 sprays in a modern design!

product.description:
The testo 770-3 clamp meter is the ideal clamp amperemeter for demanding measuring tasks in tight application environments. The movable pincer arm can be fully retracted into the instrument. This enables the instrument to grab tightly packed cables in a particularly accurate way.

Thanks to improved resolution, high-precision results are also generated in the lower current range. The testo 770-3 also has an extended voltage measurement range of up to 1000 V.

In addition, more specialized applications can be handled using the clamp meter, such as starting current, power and μA measurements. The optionally available temperature adapter for thermocouple probes can be used to measure electrical parameters as well as temperatures (compatible Type K thermocouple probe can be ordered separately).

The clamp amperemeter automatically detects and selects AC/DC and other parameters, such as resistance, continuity, diode and capacitance,. This makes operation easier and more reliable than ever before.

The measurement values can be clearly shown on the two-part display of the clamp meter and in the testo Smart App. The testo 770-3 can be quickly and easily connected to the testo Smart App and other Testo measuring instruments via Bluetooth. In the App, you can display the measurement curve as a graph on your smartphone/tablet and save and send readings directly in the report.

product.name: JG Underfloor Lowfit Castellated Panel 16mm For 12mm Pipe Jglowfit16
product.description:
John Guest Speedfit LowFit™ 16mm Castellated Panels are designed to provide a high output and low height screed floor underfloor system.

The 16mm panel has equally spaced castellations at 50mm to allow 12mm pipe to be clipped in securely and accurately as per design specifications.

Installation of the panels is fast and simple as it features an overlapping alignment system for simple hassle-free panel laying, as well as a super strong adhesive backing. This allows for the panel to be installed directly onto the existing sub floor structure. The open grid design ensures the screed layer poured on top flows smoothly and evenly over the panel.

product.name: JG Underfloor Lowfit Foiled Panel 16mm For 12mm Pipe Jglowfit16F
product.description:
John Guest Speedfit LowFit™ Foil Panels are designed to be installed over existing timber or concrete floors, while maintaining a low overall floor height. 

The 16mm panel is lightweight with high compressive strength and is  pre-grooved with return bends to eliminate the need for additional panel variations. Foil is moulded into the straight grooves to enhance system performance. 

Return bends can be easily cut with a small knife to suit the system design and speed up installation.

product.name: JG Underfloor Manifold Connection Kit MEXT452301
product.description:
John Guest Speedfit Underfloor Manifold Connection Kit is designed for connecting multiple John Guest Speedfit LowFit or John Guest Speedfit Underfloor Manifolds together. It is an ideal solution for larger properties that require multiple loops per room, or when additional underfloor heating (UFH) circuits are required on an existing installation.

The kit is easy to installl and comes complete with sealing washers. Simply remove the blanking plugs from the existing manifold at the end of both flow and return bars. Insert the sealing washer into the connectors and tighten. The additonal manifold can then be connected to the other end, creating further circuits, whilst still using a single JG Underfloor Thermomix Control Kit. 

The manifold flow meters will need to be recalibrated after installation on both manifolds to ensure optimum performance.

product.name: JG Underfloor Lowfit Fibre Mesh Panel 16mm For 12mm Pipe Jglowfit16M

product.description:
This elegant Heritage Hartlebury concealed shower control with an integrated dual outlet diverter in a brilliant chrome finish brings classic style and modern functionality to your bathroom. Created by the trusted experts at Heritage, this classic fixture is designed to be recessed directly into your wall, presenting a neat and uncluttered look that maximises your showering area. By hiding the bulky working parts behind your tiles, you can enjoy a clean aesthetic that complements both traditional and transitional decor themes. The gleaming chrome surface catches the light beautifully, adding a touch of timeless sophistication to your sanctuary while being remarkably easy to wipe clean.

Homeowners with limited wall depth will appreciate the incredibly compact engineering of this model. It stands out as the most compact concealed option currently available, meaning it can slide effortlessly into exceptionally shallow wall cavities that would usually restrict your choice of brassware. This ultra-slim profile ensures that even homes with challenging architectural constraints or narrow partition walls can accommodate a high-performance built-in system without requiring extensive structural modification or false wall construction.

When it comes to performance, this unit is engineered specifically to suit the unique requirements of British plumbing systems. It is fully capable of operating efficiently across a wide spectrum of household water pressures, meaning you can enjoy reliable performance whether your home features a gravity-fed setup or a high-pressure mains system. The internal mechanics are tuned to deliver a generous and satisfying volume of water, transforming your daily routine into a fully immersive and soaking experience that rivals a luxury spa. With the built-in diverting component, you can effortlessly switch the water flow between dual outlets, such as a fixed overhead deluge and a practical handset, giving you total control over how you bathe.

At the heart of the unit are premium ceramic discs which replace traditional rubber washers. These discs are incredibly resistant to wear, preventing annoying drips and ensuring that the control handles turn with absolute smoothness every single time you use them. This advanced cartridge technology not only enhances your daily comfort by making temperature and flow adjustments effortless, but it also ensures that the fixture will remain a durable and reliable centerpiece in your home for many years to come.

product.name: Fernox Antifreeze Valve SV 62750
product.description:
The Fernox TF1 Antifreeze Valve is specifically designed to protect water-based air source Heat Pump heating systems. In cold weather when temperatures drop, systems that are not treated with a glycol-based fluid can freeze within the heat pump circuit potentially causing harmful and costly damage to vulnerable heat pump components and system pipework; eventually causing premature breakdown and repair.

The Fernox TF1 Antifreeze Valve is an essential, simple to install component developed to prevent frozen systems by detecting when the fluid in the circuit is close to freezing point i.e., when the circuit temperature reaches below 3° C. The TF1 Antifreeze Valve will automatically open and release system water, preventing ice from forming within the Heat Pump system and safeguarding the operation of the system.

The RainSelect concealed thermostatic mixer with 4 outlets is seamlessly integrated into the wall and is impressively user-friendly. product.name: Roca Insignia built-in thermostatic mixer with 2 outlets 200(W) x 180(D) x 160(H)mm chrome - RocaBox concealed shower valve required for installation A5A0C3AC00
product.description:
This Roca built-in thermostatic mixer offers a stylish and highly functional solution for modern family bathrooms. Designed with a gorgeous chrome finish, this premium brassware brings a brilliant shine and outstanding durability to your showering space. The sleek design measures 200mm x 180mm, making it a compact yet impactful addition to any contemporary wall. This unit features gentle curves and a sophisticated personality that perfectly suits bathrooms with a distinct urban style. With its slender side lever, adjusting the water is incredibly smooth and intuitive, providing a clean minimalist look that keeps clutter to a minimum.

At the heart of this showering component is an advanced thermostatic cartridge. This high-performing cartridge ensures that your water temperature remains perfectly stable throughout your shower, protecting your family from sudden cold spikes or unexpected hot scalding. The system boasts a quick reaction with temperature change, instantly adjusting to fluctuations in your home water supply to keep the flow safe and comfortable. Additionally, the outer surfaces are treated with the signature Roca Evershine finish. This specialised plating process ensures a long-lasting, bright chrome glow that resists scratches and makes cleaning incredibly easy, requiring only a quick wipe to maintain its mirror-like lustre.

To achieve a neat and flush look in your bathroom, this thermostatic valve is designed for concealed installation. Please note that the dedicated RocaBox concealed shower valve is required to complete the setup behind the wall. By housing the working components inside the wall cavity, you gain more physical space in your enclosure while creating a high-end, hotel-style aesthetic. The unit is designed to feed multiple outlets, allowing you to easily switch between your chosen shower heads or handset attachments for a fully personalised bathing experience. This mixer combines exceptional Spanish engineering with beautiful aesthetics to deliver a luxurious daily routine for years to come.

product.name: BoilerMag XT 4" with AAV BMXT200/4/AAV
product.description: Industrial BoilerMag XT. Industrial Heating System Protection. Ideal for large heating systems and cooling systems, Boilermag XT prevents the build-up of ferrous oxide and scale in central heating systems, reducing energy bills, increasing boiler life and reducing maintenance call outs. Utilising our high performance flow technology, Boilermag XT ensures that virtually 100% of unwanted debris is removed from the system. Boilermag XT is a full flow filter, which filters 100% of the water on a single pass. A full flow filter is fitted in-line within the main circulation, hence 100% of system water passes through it. This allows the BoilermagXT to extract all the black sludge with first pass efficiency. It is vital that magnetite is extracted immediately from the circulation before it reaches the boiler. The side stream method is a risky option as magnetite can be left to circulate several times before being captured, in the meantime potentially causing damage to the system.

product.description: This product has been discontinued and is reduced to clear. The Baxi Domestic Hot Water 10 Plate Heat Exchanger 7225724 is a brand new, genuine Baxi spare part with a Baxi manufacturer's guarantee. The Heat Exchanger is a vital component that facilitates the transfer of heat from the burner to the water within a heating system. These parts are categorised into two separate types, the Primary Heat Exchanger and the Secondary Heat Exchanger. The Primary is found within almost all boiler systems whereas a Secondary is only found within Combination systems to allow the heat to be transferred between the two closed systems.

product.name: Grundfos COMFORT 15-14 B T GB 93095535
product.description:
COMFORT T is an efficient circulator designed for hot-water recirculation in residential buildings with a dedicated return line. It is compatible with all types of water heater tanks, tankless systems, solar or heat pumps regardless of whether the system has mixing or tampering valves installed.

The pump features a compact housing and a permanent magnet with an integrated control unit. The spherical rotor, equipped with an impeller, ensures optimal functionality supported by a robust single-bearing ball system. The drinking-water approved brass pump housing guarantees both safety and reliability. COMFORT T moreover features a built-in temperature sensor to maintain water temperature.

COMFORT T features the temperature control mode that automatically activates the pump when the internal temperature sensor detects that the water temperature drops below a certain level. The control mode automatically adjusts the on/off temperature based on the maximum temperature measured in the system. The maximum temperature of the system is measured every 12 hours for 15 minutes, enabling dynamic adjustment of the on/off temperature.

product.name: Heatmiser neoStat V3 12V Smart Thermostat - White neoStat V312VWHITE
product.description:
The Heatmiser neoStat 12V is a 12V powered smart thermostat that offers advanced features and app control. It is the perfect upgrade option for those who want to take advantage of app control and have existing low voltage cabling installed. The neoStat 12V is compatible with our 12V Wiring Centre UH8-N and previous generation UH1 systems.

Key Features:

App Control: Take full control of your heating system with the Heatmiser app, allowing you to adjust temperature settings, program schedules, and monitor your heating from anywhere using your smartphone or tablet.
Easy Upgrade: The neoStat 12V is designed as an easy upgrade route, making use of existing low voltage cabling, saving time and effort during installation.
Mesh Networking: The neoStat communicates wirelessly with the neoHub, forming a reliable and scalable network system. Each mains powered neoStat acts as a repeater, ensuring a strong and stable signal throughout your home.
Flexible Operation: The neoStat can be configured to function as a thermostat or as a timer. This means you can take control of not only your heating but also other devices such as towel rails or lighting, offering you greater convenience and flexibility.
Easy Navigation: The neoStat series features an intuitive and user-friendly programming system, with all options conveniently displayed at the bottom of the backlit display.
Self Learning Preheat: The self-learning preheat feature calculates the optimal heat-up time to ensure your home is warm and comfortable when you wake up or return home. It continuously adjusts and optimizes this preheat time throughout the year, helping you save energy and money.
Programmable Modes: Choose between thermostat mode or timer mode to suit your heating preferences and requirements.
Holiday Function: The neoStat includes a holiday function that allows you to set a specific temperature or turn off the heating completely when you're away, helping you save energy and maintain control even when you're not at home.
Temperature Hold: The temperature hold feature allows you to set a desired temperature for a specific duration. After the set time expires, the thermostat will return to its normal programmed settings.
Air Sensor Connection: Connect an air sensor to the neoStat to measure and control the temperature in a specific location, providing accurate and localized temperature readings.
Floor Sensing Mode: The neoStat supports floor sensing mode (probe not included), enabling precise temperature control in electric floor heating systems.
Upgrade to the Heatmiser neoStat 12V Smart Thermostat and experience the convenience of app control, advanced features, and flexible programming options. Take control of your heating system and enjoy a comfortable home environment with ease.

product.name: Plumbright 22mm Compression Electrolytic Scale Reducer PBE/22/CPS
product.description: The Plumbright electrolytic scale reducer provides high performance protection against limescale deposits. This electrolytic scale reducer can extend the lifespan of the heating system and improve operating efficiency. Part L of the Building Regulations states that where mains water hardness exceeds 200 ppm the water in the hot water circuit must be treated to reduce the rate of limescale deposition and in doing so maintain energy efficiency. As specified in the Domestic Services Compliance Guide an Electrolytic Scale Reducer is the most efficient treatment method.

product.name: Plumbright 15mm Compression Magnetic Scale Reducer PBM/15/CPS
product.description: Plumbright Magnetic Scale Reducers (MSR) can be used in both domestic and commercial properties. Magnetic Scale Reducers are recommended as single appliance protection installation. The MSR can be fitted vertically or horizontally and there is no preferred direction of flow. It includes simple compression fittings for easy connection to standard pipe. The MSR consists of a copper body with a permanent magnet inside. Magnetic Scale Reducers are installed to help prevent the build-up of limescale formation (mainly made from calcium carbonate) in appliances. By preventing limescale formation, the damaging potential reduction in operational life of the appliances and the costly drop in efficiency can both be reduced or minimised. An MSR creates a magnetic field which changes the crystal structure of calcium carbonate making it less likely to cluster as limescale on heat exchangers, elements and pipework.

As your household power needs grow, this flexible Solax system can be easily expanded. product.name: Stelrad 1800 x 640mm Slimline Concord Radiator 148303C
product.description:
This elegant designer radiator from Stelrad offers a stylish and highly practical heating solution for modern homes, combining an attractive aesthetic with reliable home heating. Measuring 1800mm in height by 640mm in length, this tall and slender unit is specifically designed to help you make the most of your available wall space. The vertical configuration featuring slim, flat tubes ensures that the radiator can slot easily into narrower areas, allowing you to maximise layout potential in your living room, hallway, or kitchen without sacrificing any precious floor space.

As standard, this model comes finished in a crisp and clean white RAL9016 paint, which provides a bright and timeless look that will blend beautifully with almost any home interior decor style. To suit the specific heating needs of your individual room, you have the flexibility to select either a single or double tubed option depending on how much warmth your space requires.

This unit is designed to be fit for the future because it is fully compatible with modern, low temperature heating systems, helping you transition to more efficient energy setups in the home. Operating with a working pressure of 4.6 bar, it offers a highly dependable heating performance that you can rely on day after day. For added reassurance, Stelrad provides a comprehensive five year warranty with this product, ensuring your home stays warm, cosy, and comfortable for many years to come.

product.name: hansgrohe Raindance Select E TSM Set 120 with Ecostat Select, Chrome 27038000
product.description:
Hansgrohe designed this shower set with a 120 mm shower head, a 0.65 m Unica rail, and a 1.60 m anti-kink hose in a chrome finish. The exposed thermostatic mixer maintains your chosen water temperature while using CoolContact technology to keep the outer casing cool during operation. 

You can alternate between three spray patterns using the integrated Select push button, including air-infused RainAir droplets, a full Rain setting, and a Whirl option featuring three rotating sprays. Flexible silicone QuickClean nozzles on the 120 mm spray disc allow limescale to be wiped away by hand.

This wall-mounted fitting connects to standard G 1/2 DN15 S-unions with a 150 ± 12 mm pipe centre distance. Hansgrohe guarantees spare parts availability for up to 15 years after discontinuation of this model line.

The Pulsify Select 105 Relaxation shower set by hansgrohe with thermostat and 0.90 m shower rod gives you that daily feel-good shower you want along with all the comforts. There are three shower sprays and they can be changed at the touch of a button (Select): hansgrohe PowderRain gently envelops your body in a cocoon of the finest of water droplets. IntenseRain invigorates and is perfect for rinsing out shampoo. The third type of spray is a pampering massage spray.
The large shelf on the thermostat offers plenty of space for personal care products, and the shower head in the side-integrated holder is always within reach. The shower can be switched on and off with the Select buttons, like a light switch. The water quantity and temperature can be conveniently regulated using the large turning handle. This enables effortless operation and, if desired, a flow rate reduction of up to 30%.
Clever details for long-lasting showering pleasure Thanks
to its modern chrome and graphite gray combination, the Pulsify shower system with its proven hansgrohe quality provides you with an innovative, permanent shower solution with individual appeal. The timeless design with round shower head makes Pulsify your ideal companion, whatever the desired bathroom ambience.

product.name: hansgrohe RainSelect TSM Valve, 2 Outlets and Shower Holder, Chrome 15355000
product.description:
Designed by Hansgrohe for concealed wall mounting, this chrome-finished thermostatic mixer valve operates two water outlets. Two mechanical control dials regulate the water temperature and flow volume across an overhead shower and hand shower. Water activates or stops via large, soft-click push buttons marked with wear-resistant symbols, allowing both outlets to run simultaneously. 

Constructed with a chrome-plated metal casing, the unit integrates a built-in shower holder to store the hand shower head directly on the wall. The internal thermostatic cartridge compensates for pressure fluctuations to maintain a stable output temperature. An integrated SafetyStop safety lock limits the temperature until an override button is pressed, protecting against scalding up to a maximum limit configured during installation. A built-in shut-off function halts flow when pressure is applied to the push buttons during cleaning. Installation requires a waterproof, sound-insulated base set for two consumers under part number 15310180, which is sold separately.

product.name: hansgrohe Raindance Select S TSM Set 240, Chrome 27129000
product.description:
Designed by Hansgrohe for surface mounting onto existing pipework, this chrome shower system includes a round 240 mm overhead shower head and a 1.60 m Isiflex hose. The overhead unit features a non-drip spray face with an integrated Select button to toggle between soft rain and a firm central spray. An accompanying hand shower offers three spray options including RainAir, Rain, and WhirlAir massage, switched at the touch of a button. 

To prevent scalding, the Ecostat Comfort thermostat incorporates a patented Hansgrohe cartridge with a safety stop fixed at 40°C. User-friendly rotary controls on the valve provide precise adjustment of both water temperature and flow rate. Flexible QuickClean silicon nozzles allow limescale to be wiped away using a finger. The kit is complete with a height-adjustable hand shower bracket and a pop-up waste set that opens and closes the drain with a single hand movement.

product.description:
Elegant shower hose box offering more comfort and space
The clever shower hose system sBox finish set oval by hansgrohe coils up the hose beneath the bathtub rim. That provides additional space, a more beautiful appearance and more comfort at the tub. If needed the hose can be pulled-out up to 1.45 m. The protected hose guidance operates especially quiet, smooth and reliable.

The hansgrohe sBox is suitable for rim or tile mounted installation alike (minimum width of the rim 71 mm). Now the shower hose disappears invisible behind the tub. The hose connector is compatible to all standard hand showers with G1/2 connector. The hansgrohe sBox is also available with a square escutcheon by request (art. no. 28010000).
Tidy installation
The sBox finish set oval will be installed on the sBox rim and tile mounted bath basic set (art. no. 13560180). It is sold separately. A specific holder prevents the hose connector from falling under the bath tub. For tile installation of the sBox an installation plate (art. no. 28016000) and two mounting angles (art. no. 28021000) are required additionally.
More advantages
The sBox supersedes the previous bathtub system hansgrohe Secuflex, and offers many advantages by direct comparison:

     30 % more hose extension length
     50 % less traction when pulled-out
     60 % less holding force needed
hansgrohe. The beauty of water

product.description:
Finished in chrome, this Hansgrohe single-lever basin mixer (product code 72011000) features a ComfortZone 80 height to give extra clearance above the washbasin. The single pin handle allows direct adjustment of the water temperature and volume. 

An internal EcoSmart limiter caps the flow rate at 5 l/min, reducing overall water consumption by up to 50 percent compared to standard taps. product.name: Hansgrohe Talis S Basin Mixer Tap for concealed installation wall-mounted with spout 225 cm, Chrome 72111000

An AirPower feature mixes air into the flow to create a fuller, softer water jet that minimises splashing in the basin. Limescale buildup can be wiped away quickly using the flexible silicone tip featuring QuickClean technology. 

During installation, you can position the operating handle on either the left or right side of the spout depending on the positioning of the wall-mounted base unit. The tap includes a screen valve that keeps the waste open at all times, preventing flooding in basins without an overflow channel. To protect users, you can configure a temperature limit when installing the unit to prevent scalding, and the system is compatible with continuous flow water heaters. Hansgrohe guarantees that replacement parts will remain available for 15 years after the product line has ended.

product.name: Ideal Heating Ideal Boilers Harrier GTS6 Boiler Only 203833
product.description:
The Harrier GTS boilers are a range of cast iron sectional pressure
jet boilers offering high efficiency operation, ease of maintenance,
fuel flexibility and low emissions. Suitable for oil or gas operation
the Harrier GTS range is supplied in a choice of 5 standard
models, rated in outputs from 105kW (358,000 Btu/h) to 330kW
(1,126,000 Btu/h) and has a maximum operating pressure of 6 bar.
All models may have high/low operation.
Designed with a large combustion chamber, 3 pass horizontal flue
ways incorporating fins and cast iron turbulators, the Harrier GTS
ensures maximum heat transfer efficiency (up to 91.5% net).
The boilers are suitable for: combined indirect pumped domestic
hot water and central heating systems; independent indirect
pumped domestic hot water or central heating systems.
Fully pumped systems may be open vented or sealed.
The boilers are NOT suitable for:
1. Gravity DHW systems
2. Gravity heating systems
3. Direct domestic hot water supply

product.description: This angled thermostatic valve set from Plumbright features a matching lockshield and a sleek chrome finish, designed to provide efficient temperature management for household heating systems. Inside the valve, a liquid-filled sensor continuously monitors the surrounding air, reacting swiftly to changes in room temperature to maintain a comfortable living space. Manufactured from high-quality brass coated in shiny chrome, this durable set is engineered to resist corrosion, ensuring your home heating remains dependable for many years to come. The user-friendly wheel-head controller has a highly visible dial, allowing you to choose between five distinct levels of warmth with complete precision. Because the flow can run in either direction, this unit offers maximum flexibility during setup, fitting easily onto your pipework without fuss. An integrated safety feature guards your plumbing against freezing, automatically opening the valve if temperatures drop dangerously low during winter. It connects securely via a fifteen-millimetre threaded inlet to a half-inch compression outlet, standing up to water pressures of ten bar and regulating temperatures up to twenty-eight degrees Celsius. This stylish addition to your home not only looks great with its bright metallic exterior, but it also plays a key role in reducing energy waste by ensuring you only heat rooms when necessary. Homeowners will appreciate the classic styling of the column head design, which blends effortlessly with both traditional and contemporary radiator styles. Adjusting the warmth in your bedroom, living room, or hallway becomes an effortless task, giving you total control over your home environment throughout the changing seasons. The inclusion of a matching lockshield means you can balance your heating system once and enjoy consistent, even warmth across all your radiators without needing further adjustments.

product.name: LONGi Hi-Mo X10 480W All Black Solar Panel

product.name: ProWarm XP-Pro Insulation Board - 6mm
product.description:
ProWarm XP-PRO Insulation Boards are specially designed to provide excellent insulation and support for our electric underfloor heating systems on concrete or screeded floors. Key Features:

High-Quality Insulation: XP-PRO Insulation Boards offer superior thermal insulation properties, making them an ideal choice for improving the energy efficiency of your underfloor heating system.
Multiple Thickness Options: Available in 6mm, 10mm, 20mm, 30mm, and 50mm thicknesses, these boards provide flexibility to meet various installation requirements and insulation needs.
Compatibility with Underwood Heating Systems: XP-PRO boards can be used as top-quality insulation for underwood heating systems. Simply lay the boards in a staggered brick bond pattern and place the heating mat over the top for a seamless installation.
High Compressive Strength: With a compressive strength of 30 tonnes/m², these boards offer excellent stability and durability, ensuring long-lasting performance.
Lightweight and Cost-Effective: The lightweight nature of XP-PRO boards simplifies handling and installation while keeping the overall project cost low.
Approved by UltraTile: These insulation boards are fully approved by UltraTile, a trusted name in the industry, guaranteeing their reliability and quality.
Installation:

The installation method for ProWarm XP-PRO boards depends on the type of heating system being installed:

Underwood Heating System: Lay the boards in a staggered brick bond pattern, and then place the heating mat directly over the boards for optimal performance.
Under Tile System: When using XP-PRO boards for under tile systems (suitable for concrete subfloors only), the boards must be securely fixed to the subfloor using a suitable flexible tile adhesive. This ensures stability and proper heat distribution for your underfloor heating system.

Dimensions: 1200mm x 600mm

This Stelrad horizontal double panel radiator provides a highly efficient heating solution for domestic and commercial environments. This high-performing heating unit measures 450mm x 900mm, making it an ideal choice for installations where wall space is constrained but high thermal output is required. Manufactured by an industry-leading brand, this model comes from the most popular compact radiator collection in the United Kingdom, offering an extensive selection of sizes to suit any room configuration. 

Designed with a double panel and two convectors, this K2 configuration maximises heat distribution while maintaining a neat profile. The outer casing features a factory-fitted top grille paired with side panels to ensure they are securely integrated. This precise engineering eliminates any rattle or shifting, ensuring a secure and neat finish once installed on the wall brackets. 

From a technical perspective, installers can specify this product with complete confidence. The manufacturing process adheres strictly to ISO 9000 quality management systems, ensuring consistent production standards and reliable material thickness. Furthermore, the unit fully conforms to BS EN 442, which is the official European standard for radiators, guaranteeing verified heat outputs and safe operation. 

This radiator is engineered to withstand a maximum working pressure of 10 bar, which is equivalent to a guaranteed performance level of up to 145 psi. Such pressure capabilities make it suitable for a wide range of sealed and open-vented central heating setups. Depending on the system configuration and flow rates, the broader range can deliver heat outputs starting from 648 up to 20079 BTU per hour, allowing for flexible heating designs.

product.name: Stainlesslite Plus Hp Cylinder 300 PLUHP300DUO
product.description:
Built from the ground up the Gledhill Heat Pump Duo cylinder has been specifically designed to work with air and ground source heat pumps. The Gledhill heat pump cylinder is a 2-in-1 cylinder design that features a 70L internal expansion tank removing the need of using an external expansion storage tank.

As the Heat Pump Duo cylinder has been designed and engineered to work with all major heat pump cylinders, the Gledhill Duo utilises a 2.5 – 4m² corrugated steel coil offering a larger surface area. Together with Gledhill’s unique multi-pass technology which incorporates 3 heat exchange coils within the cylinder allows the heat pump duo cylinder to simultaneously heat 3 individual areas which increases efficiency and overall increases the efficiency in which the heat pump cylinder heats the water.

An additional benefit of the 70L internal expansion tank that the Gledhill heat pump cylinder features is that this tank stores the heat generated by the heat pump which keeps the water warmer for longer but also filters that heat through the radiator system the central heating system hot just like traditional boiler operated system which in turn allows the heat pump to work more efficiently at heating water. In addition, as the cylinder is made from high quality duplex stainless steel, the Gledhill heat pump duo cylinder is one of the lightest cylinders on the market.

product.name: Robert Bosch EXPERT HEX-9 Hard Ceramic Drill Bit 6x90mm
product.description: Lasts up to 10x longer than Bosch CYL-9 Ceramic Drill bit - As wall tiles have become larger and harder, drilling holes in them has become very demanding on a tile drill bit. That’s why Bosch has developed the EXPERT HardCeramic Drill Bit, which is capable of dry-drilling hard ceramics and lasts far longer than our benchmark drill bit for tiles. This specialist hard ceramic bit uses Bosch’s Carbide Technology – the hardest of metals – and combines it with an advanced multi-faceted tip design that shares the workload over multiple asymmetric faces. This complex drill bit tip, achievable through fine grinding manufacturing technique, also enables a precise start without skidding and scratching. The Bosch EXPERT HEX-9 HardCeramic Drill Bit is designed for drilling ceramics and can drill holes in hard tiles without lubricant or cooling. Hex shank for a strong connection and maximum torque transmission in three-jaw chucks and ¼" internal hex tool holders.

product.name: Stelrad Elite K1 Single Panel Radiator 600mm x 500mm 8529.
product.description:
This Stelrad single panel radiator is engineered to deliver reliable and efficient heating performance for domestic and commercial projects. Measuring 600mm x 500mm, this high-performance panel radiator conforms fully to the BS EN 442 standard, assuring installers of its thermal outputs and quality. Manufactured under the strict ISO 9000 quality management system, the unit represents a highly dependable choice for heating professionals who require consistency and durability in their installations.

To achieve optimal heating efficiency, the convectors are precision welded directly onto the waterways. This direct contact enhances thermal transfer, providing greater efficiency and economy during operation. The system is built to withstand high-pressure environments, boasting a maximum working pressure of 145 pounds per square inch, which is equivalent to 10 bar.

For ease of handling and installation on site, the product features a new packaging design. This protective wrap shields the unit throughout storage and transit, and it is cleverly designed to allow for installation prior to removal, keeping the radiator clean and safe from damage during building works.

The engineering excellence is evident in the alignment of the connection points. Every tapping aligns perfectly, fitted with top-grade nickel-plated plugs and air vents. Leak prevention is secured by O-rings fabricated from ethylene, propylene, and diene monomer. Crisp definition pressings create completely smooth corners and outer edges, minimising safety hazards. Finally, a flawless, drip-free finish comprising two coats of paint ensures the unit integrates with any interior styling. Stelrad has dedicated significant capital funding to ensure this range delivers excellent quality and reliable performance.

product.name: Stelrad Compact K2 Double Panel Horizontal Radiator 450mm x 800mm 143720.
product.description:
This Stelrad horizontal double panel radiator provides a reliable and highly efficient heating option for a wide variety of modern properties. Designed to fit into areas with limited wall space, this specific K2 model measures 450mm x 800mm, making it an excellent choice for compact rooms or under-window installations. As part of the most popular and extensive compact radiator collection in the United Kingdom, this Stelrad unit represents a proven standard of dependable thermal output.

For professional installers requiring precise technical assurances, this unit is manufactured under strict ISO 9000 quality management systems. This guarantees that every component meets rigorous production standards before leaving the factory. Furthermore, the radiator fully conforms to BS EN 442, which is the official European standard for radiator performance and safety. This compliance ensures that all heat outputs are certified and accurate for heating system designs.

In terms of system pressure, the radiator is guaranteed to perform reliably up to a maximum working pressure of 145 psi, which corresponds to an operating limit of 10 bar. Depending on the specific system configuration, the product family delivers outputs ranging from 648 to 20079 BTU per hour, providing significant versatility for different heating requirements.

The double panel, double convector configuration of the K2 design maximises heat emission while maintaining a low-profile aesthetic on the wall. By utilising both front and back panels alongside internal convectors, the unit ensures rapid warmth distribution throughout the target space. The construction features integrated side panels and top grilles. These parts are specifically engineered to eliminate any potential movement, ensuring a firm, stable, and highly professional alignment once the installation is complete.

product.description:
The Towelrads Ascot single panel radiator offers a stylish and highly functional heating solution for any room in your home. This designer radiator provides a contemporary twist on classic heating units, making it an ideal choice for both modern and traditional interiors. Crafted by Towelrads, this elegant aluminium radiator is available in a sophisticated white and anthracite finish to complement your home decor. Measuring 600mm x 407mm, this model fits beautifully into spaces where wall area is limited, without compromising on performance.

Aluminium is the core material here, chosen for its outstanding thermal properties. This metal can transfer heat five times faster than traditional steel equivalents, ensuring your living space warms up rapidly. Because of this quick thermal response, the unit distributes warmth much more efficiently. This means the designer radiator can be considerably more compact than a standard steel heat emitter while still generating an equivalent thermal output. Consequently, you can enjoy a cosy room at a reduced running cost, saving money on your utility bills.

In addition to its energy-saving capabilities, this product is constructed from recycled components, making it a responsible choice for environmentally conscious homeowners. The sleek, slimline profile ensures it does not protrude excessively into your living areas. Because of its lightweight design, carrying and installing the unit is a much simpler and safer process for your installer.

Engineered to meet high standards, this designer heating unit is capable of managing a maximum working pressure of 10 bar, making it suitable for a wide range of domestic central heating systems. It also boasts a maximum working temperature of 95C, ensuring reliable operation during the coldest winter months. Whether you are refurbishing your lounge, updating your kitchen, or adding warmth to a hallway, this versatile single panel option delivers outstanding performance, sustainability, and aesthetic appeal.

product.description:

As a standout choice in the designer radiators category, this Towelrads heating unit is ideal for bringing warmth to any room in your home. Measuring 600mm x 1432mm, this model features an eye-catching design available in white and anthracite finishes to suit your personal interior style.

This aluminium radiator offers a contemporary twist on classic radiator styles, meaning it is perfectly suited for any room in your home. Because it is constructed from high-quality aluminium, this unit boasts a level of heat conductivity that is five times greater than standard steel alternatives. product.name: Mira Advance Heatloop Electric Shower 8.7 KW 1.1785.006
product.description:
This efficient electric shower from Mira delivers a sustainable and highly accessible bathing experience for the modern household. Engineered to support eco-conscious homes, this appliance is compatible with domestic waste-water warmth recycling systems, allowing you to reclaim heat from draining water to preheat incoming supplies. By integrating this technology, users can enjoy a massive reduction in their hot water power consumption. Specifically, you can cut down on showering energy usage by up to forty percent when compared to standard electrical alternatives. This exceptional efficiency also helps to improve the overall Energy Performance Certificate rating of your property, making it an attractive addition for landlords and energy-conscious homeowners alike.

In addition to outstanding efficiency, the unit is built to withstand the challenges of seasonal weather changes. When the cold winter months arrive and mains water temperatures drop, the system automatically compensates for flow fluctuations. This ensures that you receive a reliable and stable stream of warm water without sudden drops in pressure or temperature, ensuring a comfortable experience all year round.

Safety and usability are at the heart of this design, which has been honoured with the RNIB Tried and Tested award. It features highly accessible controls with high contrast on critical touchpoints, ensuring that users with visual impairments or limited dexterity can operate the settings with confidence and ease. To prevent any risk of scalding, installers can select from four different preset maximum temperature configurations, establishing a safe thermal limit that protects children and vulnerable family members.

To guarantee a long operational life, this Mira model utilises specialised Clearscale Pro technology. This system drastically reduces the build up of limescale inside the internal components, allowing the unit to significantly outlast rival products on the market, even in areas with particularly hard water. Choosing this reliable heating appliance ensures long-term performance, safety, and remarkable utility savings.

hot water and central heating systems; independent indirect
pumped domestic hot water or central heating systems.
Fully pumped systems may be open vented or sealed.
The boilers are NOT suitable for:

product.description:
The Inta 28mm Zero Anti-Freeze Valve constructed using high quality materials that is designed to protect heat pump systems that are operating with water. The patented Inta Zero Anti-Freeze Valves have been specifically designed to quickly and 
accurately react to the water temperature in the heat pump circuit and do not need the influence 
of the ambient temperature to operate.

ambient temperatures by directly positioning the element in the system water flow, permitting 
accurate system discharge only when its truly needed. 
A protective ring has been included in the construction to prevent system debris clogging the 
operation of the valve.

correct operation and reliability time after time.

The ProWarm Water Underfloor Heating Systems stand out as the premier choice for homeowners and tradesmen seeking to install a Premium Branded water underfloor heating kit. These systems deliver exceptional performance and reliability, ensuring efficient and comfortable heating for your home.

product.name: ProWarm Water Underfloor Heating Low Profile 18mm - Single Room - 20m2
product.description:
The ProWarm LoFlo' 18mm Single Room Water Underfloor Heating Kit Covers 20M2 and is a single zone system ' one thermostat controlling the heating system, suited for a single room. For more than one room please see our multi zone system kits.

ProWarm' LoFlo' is a unique low profile floor heating system ideal for both renovation and new build projects.

Installed over the existing floor and only 18mm in depth, ProWarm' LoFlo' allows floor heating to be installed where traditional under floor systems would either require expensive excavation or would require the floor to be raised to an unacceptable level.

ProWarm' LoFlo' panel is a fibrous panel used for heavyweight floor coverings such as ceramics, or where the floor covering needs to be secured directly to the panel, e.g. engineered wood which requires fixing down.

ProWarm' LoFlo' systems utilise a 12mm pipe at 150mm pipe centres and provide excellent response times and heat output compared with traditional built in under floor heating solutions and are therefore ideal for both traditional heating systems and low temperature renewable systems.

With a unique end support that allows the installer to simply 'SNAP-OFF' sections to leave the desired number of channels around the edge of the room. Making the installation of the leaders and perimeter loops more straightforward. It is composed of modular elements that allow different configurations: single, double, triple or quadruple system are possible, to cover the needs of medium/large condominiums and high buildings (even over 14 floors). The variable frequency drive keeps the pressure constant according to the request and also thanks to the water-cooled permanent magnet motor, it allows greater efficiency, silence and energy savings. Compatible with the DConnect service. EsyBox Max is ACS certified.

product.name: DAB Esytank Pro 250AG - Esybox Mini 60207382
product.description: Esytank Pro is designed to provide a compact water storage option for the award winning Esyline booster set range. Similar to the Esyline pump range, Esytank Pro tank systems focus on modularity, making site access easy and minimising footprint. The Esyline booster range is compact, quiet and highly efficient, providing flow rates up to 10l/s and pressure ranges up to 9.6 bar, across 1 - 3 pump booster set options. Esytank Pro tanks are fully insulated, GRP construction and WRAS approved. All Esyline booster sets are fully WRAS approved. Tank capacities range from 65L - 1500L. Pumps and controls are easily accessible and external to the tank meaning there is no requirement to touch the stored water, risking contamination and the need to drain and chlorinate after service.

product.name: JG Speedfit Straight Connector Pushfit 15mm White PEM0415W-L Pack of 10
product.description:

Designed to simplify domestic plumbing tasks, these reliable pipe fittings allow homeowners to complete projects with total confidence. The clean white finish of the connectors ensures they look neat and unobtrusive when installed in visible areas around the home. By using these pushfit components, you can bypass the complex and messy processes associated with traditional plumbing systems.

Safety and convenience are at the core of this design, which entirely removes the requirement for hot works, solder, glue, or flux. This flame-free installation method drastically reduces the risk of accidental heat damage to surrounding household surfaces, making it a perfect solution for home projects. Furthermore, this plumbing system is proven to be up to forty percent quicker to install compared to older, more traditional fitting methods. Once you have pushed the pipe fully into the socket, turning the outer collar in a clockwise direction locks it securely. If you ever need to alter your layout, the demountable nature of these connectors makes the process straightforward. To release the connection, simply loosen the threaded cap by hand, depress the collet flange against the main body, and slide the pipe out of the socket.

To provide ultimate reassurance, these connectors carry extensive industry credentials. They are fully BSI and WRAS approved, ensuring they meet the highest standards for quality and safety. Additionally, the range conforms to ISO 14001 environmental management codes. product.name: Ehs 10kW Thermal Battery 200 Litre Direct

The eSTOR™ Direct Thermal Battery is the world’s most advanced thermal energy battery, built to replace outdated, high-powered systems with a sleek, compact, and ultra-efficient solution. product.description:
The Floorwarmers Electric Underfloor Heating Mat Kit 100W offers a versatile solution for various floor coverings, ensuring exceptional reliability and hassle-free installation. Here's what you need to know about this kit:

Key Features:

Versatile Solution: Designed to cater to all types of floor coverings, offering exceptional reliability and hassle-free installation.
Long-lasting Warranty: Each product comes with a generous 25-year warranty, providing peace of mind and ensuring satisfaction.
Thermostat Options: A wide range of thermostats is available to enhance your heating experience, including advanced WiFi thermostats for smart home automation and stylish touchscreen thermostats.
Affordable Quality: Combines affordability with quality, offering excellent value for money and luxury of heated floors at an affordable price point.
Multiple Output Options: Available in 150W and 200W outputs, suitable for both primary heating and supplemental heating purposes.
Kit Includes:

Underfloor Heating Sticky Mat (Two individual mats if kit size is over 12m²)
Floor Primer: High-performance universal priming/sealing agent suitable for various substrates
Roller: High-quality roller for applying floor primer to the subfloor
Adhesive Tape: Assists in holding the mat or cable in position during installation
Digital Thermostat (if selected): Allows adjustment of heat settings for added convenience
Conduit
Specifications:

Cable Type: Twin wire cable 100w/m²
Cable Thickness: 3mm
Mat Width: 500mm
Warranty: 25-year manufacturer warranty
Tested: 100% earth screened
Cold Tail Length: 2m
Certifications: UKCA and CE Approved
Installation Guide:

Divide the floor into rectangles and calculate the area to be heated, covering approximately 90% with the heating mat.
Lay insulation boards over concrete floors to minimize heat loss and ensure quicker warm-up times.
Start laying the mat close to the thermostat, ensuring the loops are equally spaced and attaching the mat to the subfloor using the provided tape.
Install an RCD fused spur to power the thermostatic controller/programmer and the mat system, and lay the temperature probe equidistant between two cable loops.
Lay a thin, self-leveling screed over the mat or trowel flexible tile adhesive directly over the mat before laying floor tiles. Allow the adhesive to cure before switching on the system.
Note: Alternative brands of heating mats may be supplied during stock shortages.

Dual Functionality: Seamlessly works with both electric floor heating systems and water heating systems, providing flexibility and convenience for various heating applications in your home.

To give you complete peace of mind with your purchase, Heritage provides a generous guarantee package. This includes a ten-year guarantee on parts, alongside a one-year guarantee covering labour costs, reflecting the exceptional build quality and reliability of this product. While the brushed brass finish is a spectacular choice for creating a high-end, luxury feel, this model is also available in alternative finishes to suit your personal interior design preferences. product.description:
This compact single phase meter is perfect for monitoring consumption on supplies of up to 100A. Featuring a large, easy read display, this highly accurate meter is fully approved in accordance with the Measuring Instruments Directive (MID) making it suitable for billing applications.
The button on the meter allows you to scroll through Date, Time, Total Energy Consumed, (kWh), as well as Maximum Demand (kW) and when this was recorded.  The internal battery on the meter allows this data to be accessed even when the supply to the meter is not live, ideal for applications where the power supply may be switched off at times. It comes complete with our single phase security kit to deter accidental and deliberate tampering. It includes 4 meter collars to secure your meter tails and a meter seal to prevent access to terminals.

By preheating the incoming cold supply with the outgoing waste through the patented heat recovery technology, it is able to recover up to 67% of the heat going down the drain. It is around 1.7m long and is accommodated below the shower waste, alongside the soil stack. It is an ideal product for new build developments, hotels, student accommodation, home renovation, or for commercial and leisure applications with showers on the first floor and above. The Zypho PiPe 65 helps achieve maximum SAP points and rapid returns on investment. With the average family now spending more than £500 / year on showering, recovering two thirds of the heat can make a considerable difference to bills. Easy to design in to any house type, it will provide significant savings on the cost of every shower, and have a big impact on CO2 reduction.

product.description:
This stunning Heritage shower kit brings together timeless elegance and modern performance to create a luxurious bathing experience in your home. Featuring a beautiful brushed nickel finish, this collection offers a subtle, sophisticated alternative to traditional chrome, adding a warm and muted metallic glow to your bathroom decor.

The package comes fully equipped with a recessed Dawlish valve, an adjustable sliding riser rail assembly, a single-mode handset, a flexible hose, and a neat outlet for the wall. It boasts a single-outlet concealed valve configuration that utilizes dual controls, giving you the ability to alter the water flow and regulate the temperature completely independently of one another. Safe operation is at the heart of this design, which features thermostatic regulation to keep the water temperature steady, alongside an automatic shut-off mechanism that stops the flow immediately if your cold supply fails, protecting your family from sudden bursts of scalding heat or icy chills.

In terms of installation versatility, this is the most compact concealed valve currently on the market, crafted deliberately to fit into a shallow wall cavity depth of just thirty-five millimetres. Plumbing integration is kept simple and efficient with standard fifteen millimetre inlet connections that accommodate typical domestic pipework. This superb addition is part of a wider, premium range of bathroom solutions designed to accommodate every taste, from historically inspired traditional styles to clean and sophisticated contemporary classics, helping you find the perfect complement to your own unique styling preferences.

product.name: Heatmiser Edge Programmable Room Thermostat
product.description:
The Heatmiser Edge Thermostat is a powerful 230v thermostat offering advanced features and wireless compatibility with accessories such as the wireless air sensor and wireless door/window switch. Whether you need to measure temperature in another location or have a larger property, its wireless air sensor function and support for multiple sensors for averaging make it an ideal choice.

Key Features:

Wireless Air Sensor Function: Measure temperature in another location using a wireless air sensor, ideal for larger properties or monitoring specific areas.
Wireless Door/Window Switch Function: Pair with a wireless window/door switch for automatic switching to Standby Mode when a window/door is open, returning to normal mode when closed.
Upgrade Route: Ideal for upgrading from existing dial thermostats or for remote temperature monitoring.
Modbus Connectivity: Enables integration with home automation and building management systems for seamless control.
Self-Learning Preheat: Offers optimum start for efficient heating, calculating required heat-up time.
Key Locking: Provides security with PIN number key locking, preventing unauthorized tampering.
Large Display: Easy-to-read display ensures clear visibility of temperature and settings.
Flexible Programming: Choose between 5/2 day, 7-day, or 24-hour programming for customized heating schedules.
Temperature Control: Enjoy self-learning optimum start, 4 or 6 comfort levels per day, and temperature hold for precise control.
Flush Mounting: Sleek flush-mount design integrates seamlessly into home aesthetics.
Frost Protection: Built-in frost protection ensures temperatures never drop to damaging levels.
Temperature Scale: Choose between Celsius or Fahrenheit temperature scales.
Floor Sensor Mode: Supports floor sensor mode (probe not included) for accurate temperature control in electric floor heating systems.
Specifications:

Max Output: Volt Free 3A Max
Supply: 230v
Dimensions (L,H,D): 90x90x15mm
Temperature Range: 05-35°C
No. Heating Levels: 4 or 6 (selectable)
Optional Probe (not included): Room Sensor or Floor Sensor
Probe Rating: 10Kohm
IP Rating: IP20
Installation:

Loosen the screw from the bottom face of the thermostat and separate the front half from the back plate.
Terminate the edge-e as shown in the wiring diagram and screw the back plate securely into the back box.
Replace the front of the thermostat onto the back plate, securing it in place with the retaining screw.
Ensure not to install near a direct heat source or push hard on the LCD screen to avoid damage. Requires a 35mm minimum depth back box for flush mounting.
Upgrade to the Heatmiser Edge Thermostat for advanced features, wireless connectivity, precise control, and sleek design, enhancing your heating experience.

product.name: Heatmiser neoStat V3 12V Smart Thermostat - Platinum Silver neoStat V312VPLATINUM
product.description:
The Heatmiser neoStat 12V is a 12V powered smart thermostat that offers advanced features and app control. It is the perfect upgrade option for those who want to take advantage of app control and have existing low voltage cabling installed. The neoStat 12V is compatible with our 12V Wiring Centre UH8-N and previous generation UH1 systems.

Key Features:

App Control: Take full control of your heating system with the Heatmiser app, allowing you to adjust temperature settings, program schedules, and monitor your heating from anywhere using your smartphone or tablet.
Easy Upgrade: The neoStat 12V is designed as an easy upgrade route, making use of existing low voltage cabling, saving time and effort during installation.
Mesh Networking: The neoStat communicates wirelessly with the neoHub, forming a reliable and scalable network system. Each mains powered neoStat acts as a repeater, ensuring a strong and stable signal throughout your home.
Flexible Operation: The neoStat can be configured to function as a thermostat or as a timer. This means you can take control of not only your heating but also other devices such as towel rails or lighting, offering you greater convenience and flexibility.

Programmable Modes: Choose between thermostat mode or timer mode to suit your heating preferences and requirements.
Holiday Function: The neoStat includes a holiday function that allows you to set a specific temperature or turn off the heating completely when you're away, helping you save energy and maintain control even when you're not at home.
Temperature Hold: The temperature hold feature allows you to set a desired temperature for a specific duration. After the set time expires, the thermostat will return to its normal programmed settings.
Air Sensor Connection: Connect an air sensor to the neoStat to measure and control the temperature in a specific location, providing accurate and localized temperature readings.
Floor Sensing Mode: The neoStat supports floor sensing mode (probe not included), enabling precise temperature control in electric floor heating systems.
Upgrade to the Heatmiser neoStat 12V Smart Thermostat and experience the convenience of app control, advanced features, and flexible programming options. Take control of your heating system and enjoy a comfortable home environment with ease.

product.name: Greenox Ad-Blue, 10L Container. Diesel Exhaust Fluid (DEF) for vehicles with Selective Catalytic Reduction (SCR) AD910
product.description:
The AdBlue is stored in a tank on the vehicle and from there dosed automatically by the ECU directly into the exhaust gas at a rate in relation to the amount of Nitrogen Oxides (NOx) being produced by the engine. Following mixing, the AdBlue and exhaust gas mixture passes into a catalyst system where a chemical reaction takes place converting the NOx to harmless Nitrogen and Water, which are then expelled from the end of the exhaust. 

During the reaction the AdBlue is consumed and needs to be replaced by refilling the tank periodically. AdBlue® consumption is related to engine load, engine size, travelling terrain and temperature.

Each environmentally friendly 10 litre AdBlue container is manufactured with at least 30% recycled materials, with an easy grip moulded base and handy pouring spout (contained behind the rear label) for safe, clean and easy dispensing into your vehicle. The lid can be resealed and excess product used on another occasion; with a shelf life of up to 18-months (when stored or used within the UK).

product.name: Telford Immersion Heater for Stainless Steel Cylinders 575-255-0002.
product.description: The Telford immersion heater is an electric water heater that sits inside a hot-water cylinder. It acts a bit like a kettle, using an electric resistance heater to heat the surrounding water. Immersion heaters consist of a brass boss, element, thermostat pocket, and thermostat. They can be made of copper, Incoloy, or titanium and come in varying element lengths and boss thread sizes. If the cylinder is situated in a hard water area, it is recommended to use an immersion with an Incoloy or titanium element to prolong the life of the immersion. Also, if the tank is only heated via immersion and it is being used in student accommodation or in a home, it is recommended to use a titanium immersion. Immersion heaters are connected to their own power supply via a cable. They can be easily switched on and off via an external programmer, as there is no need to constantly heat the water in the unvented cylinder. The immersions are usually a specific size or style for the cylinder they are fitted to. This differs between the different manufacturers. Immersion heaters can either be used as a property's primary water heater or as a backup water heater if the cylinder is being heated indirectly by a boiler. The immersion heater itself sits inside a hot water cylinder and is powered by a strong electric current. It runs off the mains electricity and the electric resistance heater heats the water inside the tank until it reaches the designated temperature. When the temperature drops below a certain level, the immersion heater comes back on until it reaches the required heat level again.

product.name: VIRIDIAN ARCBOX SOLAR ENCLOSURE
product.description:
As solar power moves beyond government subsidy to become a home improvement option, its kerb-appeal is becoming more and more important. Integrated solar has come of age, and with Clearline Fusion the highest quality and aesthetics now come at a price competitive with above-roof solar. Roof integrated solar has always been the obvious choice when refurbishing or building a new roof. Clearline Fusion also brings high quality roof integration within reach for retrofit applications. Now more people can benefit from the advantages of going in-roof. The certified wind resistance for Clearline Fusion is more than double that of competitor products and achieves this without any modification to the roof structure below. The ArcBox enclosure simply snaps around a DC connector to ensure that if an arc ever occurs it is safely contained and doesn't spread to combustible materials in or around the solar installation. The effectiveness of the product has been independently verified by the KIWA fire test laboratory and Loughborough University.

BIPV solar installations are one application for the ArcBox since DC cabling is installed near combustible building materials. Flat roof solar installations above roof coverings such as single ply membrane or asphalt is another. Some buildings, if put out of use even temporarily, would have high knock-on consequences - hospitals, schools, care homes, and factories are applications where risks must be carefully controlled.

product.name: Stelrad E001-0600-0740 COLUMN Electric Radiator White 1,000 W
product.description:
This Stelrad white column electric radiator brings efficient warmth and a classic look to your home heating setup. Measuring 600mm high by 740mm long, this appliance is finished in a clean white colour that integrates into various home styles. Built from steel, this heater features curved vertical tubes that help the unit fit in with your existing interior decorations. It operates at 1,000 W, providing plenty of power to keep your space comfortable when the temperature drops.

Inside the unit, a special fluid is heated by an electrical element that is fully submerged within the liquid. This engineered fluid requires absolutely no maintenance and is formulated to spread warmth rapidly and uniformly across the entire surface. Because of this, the appliance projects comfortable heat out into your living space via radiation, ensuring there are no cold spots in the room. Homeowners will also appreciate that this model is Lot 20 compliant, meaning it meets modern standards for energy efficiency.

Controlling your indoor temperature is simple thanks to the clever magnetic thermostat included with every model. You can choose to leave this control unit attached directly to the metal body of the radiator, or you can detach it to manage your heating settings from a distance. This flexibility allows you to monitor and adjust the warmth from the comfort of your armchair or another convenient spot in the room.

Choosing this heating solution gives you long-term confidence in its performance. Stelrad backs this product with a two-year warranty on all of the electrical components, alongside a five-year warranty covering the heating parts. This dual guarantee ensures that your investment is well protected, keeping your household warm and cosy for many winters to come.

Equipped with triple MPPT trackers, the inverter allows 300% PV oversizing to maximize solar energy collection across multiple array orientations. A low 80V start-up voltage initiates power generation early in low-light morning conditions.

The LFP battery chemistry delivers a 95% depth of discharge alongside a 6,000-cycle service life, operating at a maximum conversion efficiency of 97.6%. This storage system provides off-grid power and double off-grid backup support via an integrated emergency power supply (EPS) function with dual EPS expansion capacity. System capacity expands by linking up to three units in parallel using an AI Link accessory.

The unit supports both wall-mounted and floor-mounted installation configurations. Integrated Wi-Fi requires no external dongle, allowing live performance tracking through the FoxCloud V2.0 mobile application over Wi-Fi, LAN, 4G, or Ethernet connections.

product.description: The Vokera heat exchanger is a replacement part for Easi-Heat Plus, Vibe, Mynute, Vision, Compact, Excel, Sabre and Maxim appliances. It comes complete with clips and O-rings. A heat exchanger is a device that transfers heat from a boiler's burner to water. product.name: UCP Heat Exchanger U177566
product.description: The UCP Heat Exchanger U177566 is a genuine unbranded alternative to the genuine OEM part (433371). This part isn't endorsed by the original manufacturer however is covered with our manufacturer's guarantee. The Heat Exchanger is a vital component that facilitates the transfer of heat from the burner to the water within a heating system. These parts are categorised into two separate types, the Primary Heat Exchanger and the Secondary Heat Exchanger. The Primary is found within almost all boiler systems whereas a Secondary is only found within Combination systems to allow the heat to be transferred between the two closed systems.

product.name: Grundfos TPE3 D 125-180 S-A-F-A-BQQE-MWA 93339277
product.description: Single-stage, close-coupled, volute twin-head pump with in-line suction and discharge ports of identical diameter. The twin-head pump is designed with two parallel power-heads. The pump is of the top-pull-out design, i.e. the power head (motor, pump head and impeller) can be removed for maintenance or service while the pump housing remains in the pipework. Each power head is fitted with an unbalanced rubber bellows seal. The shaft seal is according to EN 12756. Pipework connection is via PN 16 DIN flanges (EN 1092-2 and ISO 7005-2). Each power head is fitted with a fan-cooled, permanent-magnet synchronous motor of identical size. Each power head is fitted with a fan-cooled asynchronous motor of indentical size. The motor efficiency is classified as IE5 in accordance with IEC 60034-30-2. The motor includes a frequency converter and PI controller in the motor terminal box. This enables continuously variable control of the motor speed, which again enables adaptation of the performance to a given requirement. The pump is fitted with temperature- and differential pressure sensors.

product.name: Valway Back To Wall Toilet & Vanity Unit with Basin - White Gloss 900mm
product.description: The Valway Back To Wall Toilet & Vanity Unit with Basin in white gloss is a practical bathroom suite designed to make the most of compact spaces such as cloakrooms, en-suites, and smaller bathrooms. This combined toilet and basin unit features a modern appearance and a streamlined design to help maximise available floor area while offering essential sanitaryware in one coordinated solution. Measuring 900mm in total width, 800mm in height, and 215mm in depth, this floor-standing unit consists of a back to wall toilet with a soft close D-shaped seat and a concealed cistern operated by a push button flush. The suite includes a ceramic basin set into a slim, rectangular vanity unit with a single tap hole on the left, and is supplied without a tap or basin waste for user flexibility. Under-basin storage is provided by a cupboard with a chrome bar handle and soft closing door, allowing for discrete storage of toiletries and cleaning products. Two internal shelves help to organise contents efficiently. The white gloss finish creates a clean, contemporary look and reflects light to enhance the feel of space in smaller rooms. The ceramic basin is hardwearing and easy to keep clean, while the coordinated toilet pan matches in both colour and material for a consistent appearance. With the ability to position the toilet and vanity unit on either side, this product adapts easily to suit different bathroom layouts. The reversible basin design supports further installation flexibility, enabling the tap to be positioned where it best fits your space. The Valway Back To Wall Toilet & Vanity Unit with Basin is supplied in flat pack form with straightforward assembly. Its dimensions and practical features make it suitable for both trade and domestic customers seeking a modern, space-saving bathroom suite with integrated storage.

product.name: Valway Back To Wall Toilet & Vanity Unit with Basin - Grey Gloss 900mm
product.description: The Valway Back To Wall Toilet & Vanity Unit with Basin is a practical bathroom suite designed for space efficiency in modern settings. The set includes a back to wall toilet with a concealed cistern and soft close seat, paired with a vanity unit and a white ceramic basin. The overall width of 900mm ensures this suite fits well in medium or compact bathroom layouts, with the unit standing at 800mm high and 215mm deep. Both the toilet and basin are set within a cohesive unit, creating a tidy installation that conceals pipework and maximises floor space. The vanity unit offers internal storage behind a soft close door, finished with a straight chrome bar handle. The supplied ceramic basin is rectangular, measuring 400mm in width, and features a single tap hole positioned to the left, allowing for easy installation of a basin mixer. The furniture arrives as an easy-to-assemble flat pack. product.name: SolarEdge 440W Power Optimiser
product.description: SolarEdge is a global leader in smart energy technology: focusing on innovation and environmental protection. For over a decade, SolarEdge has aimed to revolutionise solar products by changing the way power is harvested and managed in photovoltaic (PV) systems. The SolarEdge S440-1GM4MRM is a 440W power optimiser for residential installations. Enabling PV power optimisation at the module level, the S440 is specifically designed to work with SolarEdge residential inverters and supports modules up to 440Wp. Optimisers track individual solar modules to help increase system energy production.
