product.name: SolarEdge 3.7kW String Inverter
product.description: SolarEdge is a global leader in smart energy technology: focusing on innovation and environmental protection. For over a decade, SolarEdge has aimed to revolutionise solar products by changing the way power is harvested and managed in photovoltaic (PV) systems. The SolarEdge Home-Wave Inverter uses HD-Wave technology to provide an optimised installation. This is the 3700W version and maintains all of the key characteristics of the previous screenless SetAPP inverter whilst containing an extra 'plug-in slot' for both the E-NET card and ZigBee/GSM card. Small, light, efficient and superbly reliable – SolarEdge’s single phase inverters with innovative HD-Wave technology are now a firm favourite for installers and end-customers alike. SolarEdge inverters will only work with power optimisers, which control module-level Maximum Power Point Tracking and voltage management. This means that the inverter is only responsible for DC to AC inversion – this is the secret of the HD-Wave technology. It uses smaller, lighter and more reliable thin film capacitors, allowing SolarEdge to rid most of the heavy metal parts from the inverter.

product.description: John Guest Speedfit underfloor heating system has been designed to be quick and easy to install with components designed and manufactured to ISO9001 and DIN4726. The Speedfit System has hot water pumped from a boiler to a pump pack, where it is mixed to approximately 50C and then distributed via a manifold to heating circuits made using Speedfit barrier pipe. On concrete floors, the pipe is laid on insulation and then covered with a screed, on which can be laid almost any type of floor covering. For timber floors, spreader plates are laid between the joists and the floor decking or on the underside of the floor. The Speedfit pipe is pushed into the grooves on the plates. product.description: Hep2O designed this red polybutylene barrier pipe-in-pipe with a 15mm diameter and 50m length for domestic hot and cold water services alongside central heating systems. The integrated straight coil technology ensures this polybutylene material remains completely straight when uncoiled to ease handling during installation. An In4Sure joint recognition system provides a distinct rumble sensation upon full insertion, confirming a secure fitting connection. An integrated EVOH barrier layer stops oxygen from diffusing into the system, which prevents radiator and boiler corrosion. This highly flexible polybutylene allows installers to cable the pipe around obstacles and through joists, minimising the necessity for extra joint fittings. The WRAS-approved piping is engineered and produced at the UK manufacturing facility in Doncaster. A 50-year guarantee protects this product against any defects in materials and manufacturing.

product.name: Stelrad Elite K2 Double Panel Double Convector Radiator 450mm x 1000mm 8503.
product.description:
This Stelrad double panel double convector radiator offers high-efficiency heating in a compact design suitable for domestic and commercial applications. Manufactured by Stelrad, this high-quality model from the Elite K2 range features dimensions of 450mm x 1000mm, making it an ideal choice for rooms requiring consistent warmth. To ensure the highest standards of reliability and thermal performance, the unit conforms fully to the BS EN 442 standard and is manufactured under the rigorous ISO 9000 quality system.

For tradespeople and specifiers planning modern building projects, building information modelling files are fully supported, with BIM available to streamline the digital design process. This panel radiator is engineered to withstand demanding environments, guaranteed to perform efficiently up to a maximum working pressure of one hundred and forty-five pounds per square inch, which is equivalent to ten bar.

The heating efficiency of this unit is enhanced by its design, where the convectors are precision welded directly onto the waterways. This direct welding method ensures greater economy and faster heat transfer throughout the room. Across this wider product family, heat outputs range from 648 BTU/hr to 20591 BTU/hr, catering to diverse heating demands.

This heating solution comes from a collection representing Britain's most popular choice for central heating. The manufacturer has committed significant investment to upgrade this range, resulting in enhanced build quality and improved heat output. While this model is incredibly slim for a double panel configuration, the wider collection includes an impressive selection of one hundred and eighty-three models, giving installers superb flexibility when sizing a system. To further assist with tricky installations, specialised mounting accessories are available, including floor standing support brackets that permit the unit to be securely fitted in locations where wall mounting is not feasible. With a ten-year warranty included, this reliable heating solution offers complete peace of mind for both installers and homeowners.

product.description:
The Saniflo Saniflush represents a sophisticated evolution in sanitary technology, offering a seamless blend of contemporary aesthetics and high-performance engineering. Designed for installations where conventional gravity-led drainage is either impractical or impossible, this back-to-wall rimless toilet features an integrated macerator system concealed entirely within the elegant ceramic housing.

product.name: Neomitis E-Bath Slim 300W White Smart and Connected Electric Towel Rail TTS030SW3A
product.description:
First connected towel rails with 3 wireless communication protocols!

Interoperable by construction, the connectivity guaranteed in all situations!
– Zigbee® 3.0 to join a home automation box and guarantee a level of interoperability with other products equipped with the same protocol.
– WiFi® to connect directly to the MYNEOMITIS universe.
– Bluetooth® for the configuration of the product without being connected to the box, it facilitates and secures the association of the product with the cloud it will join. But also for local control (without Internet) of the device.
Ebath includes a concentration of technologies designed for your comfort and to decrease your energy consumption while making your life easier.
Directly connectable to Internet through your Internet router, without any other accessory, and connectable via an IOT BOX using Zigbee 3.0.
It can be remote-controlled by your smartphone, tablet or computer and by voice thanks to the MYNEOMITIS free app.
Integrated remote control on the top with digital controls and backlit display on a black background for better readability, combined with a very discreet connected receiver integrated in the lower part.
With its sober design, straight profile and reduced thickness, it fits easily into bathrooms, leaving maximum space for furnishing and decorating your interior.
Thanks to the auto-programming feature, Ebath will automatically adapt with your lifestyle by forecasting your comfort needs and saving money.
The dual optimisation feature allows you to optimise your programming by favouring comfort or savings.
The adjustable 60-minute boost mode, rapidly rises the heat of the bathroom and enables quick drying of clothes or wet towels.

product.name: Plasson Meter Box 3513A

This Plasson meter box base is designed to provide a stable and secure foundation for compatible utility meter boundary boxes. The material selection ensures excellent resistance to environmental stress cracking, biochemical attack from acidic or alkaline soils, and physical impacts. By utilising this specific polymer, the component maintains its structural integrity when subjected to constant ground pressure and potential shifting over time.

For professional plumbing contractors and utility installers, this product simplifies the groundworks phase of a water meter installation. It provides a flat, level surface that prevents the overlying meter enclosure from tilting or sinking, which could otherwise place undue stress on the connected water pipework and joints. This accessory is designed to work in conjunction with the corresponding Plasson meter boxes, facilitating a straightforward assembly process on site. This high-performance double panel radiator from Stelrad provides a dependable heating solution designed specifically for modern domestic and commercial installations. Measuring 600mm x 700mm, this compact unit fits neatly into standard spaces while delivering exceptional thermal performance. It represents a key component in the nation's favourite radiator line, making it a reliable choice for professional installers who require consistency and quality. The double panel K2 configuration ensures a high heat output, making it suitable for rooms that require efficient warmth from a compact footprint.

Every unit is manufactured under the rigorous ISO 9000 quality system, ensuring that the production standards remain consistently high from the factory floor to the final installation. In addition, the radiator conforms to BS EN 444 standards, providing installers and end-users with complete peace of mind regarding its safety and construction quality. To aid in modern building design and project planning, Building Information Modelling files are fully supported, with BIM available for digital specification.

For tradespeople, the physical integrity of the unit during transport is critical. This model features a stylish built-in upper grille accompanied by side panels that are crafted specifically to prevent shifting. This secure alignment stays firmly in place during warehousing, transit, and subsequent fitting on site, reducing the risk of damage or loose parts during a busy installation. The system operates with a maximum working pressure of 10 bar, allowing it to handle demanding heating systems with ease. Depending on system parameters, it outputs 648 to 20079 BTU per hour, allowing for versatile heating capacity. Finally, to demonstrate the high level of overall reliability and long-term performance, the manufacturer backs this product with a comprehensive ten-year factory guarantee.

product.description: City Plumbing are your trusted heating and plumbing suppliers for the trade. Whether you are fitting a new bathroom, heating system or radiator.

product.name: Dimplex PLX200E 2.00kw LOT 20 Compliant  90744
product.description:
The powerful and efficient PLXE classic panel heater by Dimplex features a robust yet compact design with gentle curves and a louvred grille. It is ideal for any living space in houses or apartments, the care sector and light commercial applications. The familiar footprint and cable entry location make it the industry’s go-to solution for all projects where efficiency is key.  PLXE gives the user complete control over their heating comfort and energy usage with the intuitive onboard controls. The backlit LCD and touch-sensitive buttons make programming quick and easy.

PLXE is Lot 20 compliant. A host of powerful, intelligent technologies such as Adaptive Start, Open Window Detection and an electronic thermostat accurate to 0.2°C enable precise control over the indoor environment, ensure effective heating and help reduce energy usage. Adaptive Start pre-heats the room ahead of a programmed heating schedule to meet the desired target temperature at the required time. For example, where a traditional panel heater would follow a timer set to 21°C at 7am, with Adaptive Start, the PLXE will begin heating before 7am to achieve the 21°C for the required time. Open Window Detection monitors the room’s temperature whilst the panel heater attempts to achieve the desired warmth of the room. If the temperature does not change or decreases whilst heat is being emitted, the PLXE will stop heating and enter a standby mode to stop energy wastage (function can be turned off if needed for some commercial applications).

Quiet operation ensures room occupants enjoy a comfortable environment.

The PLXE classic panel heater can be remotely controlled using the Dimplex Control smartphone app when purchased alongside a radio frequency (RF) module for each heater and a Dimplex Control Hub (sold separately). This gives the user command of PLXE and all supported Dimplex products, any time, anywhere and allows for energy usage tracking of each product.

product.name: BoilerMag 15mm Compression Magnetic Scale Reducer BmmSR.
product.description: BoilerMag Magnetic Scale Reducers (MSR) can be used in both domestic and commercial properties. Magnetic Scale Reducers are recommended as single appliance protection installation. The MSR can be fitted vertically or horizontally and there is no preferred direction of flow. It includes simple compression fittings for easy connection to standard pipe. The MSR consists of a copper body with a permanent magnet inside. Magnetic Scale Reducers are installed to help prevent the build-up of limescale formation (mainly made from calcium carbonate) in appliances. By preventing limescale formation, the damaging potential reduction in operational life of the appliances and the costly drop in efficiency can both be reduced or minimised. An MSR creates a magnetic field which changes the crystal structure of calcium carbonate making it less likely to cluster as limescale on heat exchangers, elements and pipework.

product.description:
EIBENSTOCK ETN 162/3P Professional 2200w Heavy Duty Wet & Dry Diamond Core Drill with Carry Case
The EIBENSTOCK ETN 162/3P Wet and Dry Diamond Core Drill is a versatile, reliable and powerful power tool that allows you to tackle large and small capacity holes, wet or dry. The EIBENSTOCK ETN 162/3 is a professional diamond core drill featuring a 2200w motor and is equipped with a heavy duty 3 speed gearbox, the ETN 162/3 allows the user to match the required speed to the capacity hole they are tackling to ensure a clean core hole is achieved.
The ETN 162/3P features interchangeable dust extraction and water feed couplings to allow integrated dust extraction through the centre of a 1.25" UNC thread dry core bit or spindles water flow when wet drilling.
While providing a comfortable handheld drilling experience, the ETN 162/3 can be rig-mounted using an integrated quick-change locking dovetail system that supports the drill during tough applications to provide exceptional drilling accuracy, a smooth coring experience and deliver clean coring results.

The EIBENSTOCK EHD 2002 S Professional Diamond Core Drill is a heavy duty handheld power tool that is capable of dry drilling a range of materials including brick and block up to 6" / 152mm thanks to its impressive mechanical clutch and powerful 1800w motor.

Featuring excellent drill ergonomics and robust gearbox, the EHD 2002 S diamond core drill has a heavy-duty motor that is capable of outputting 1800w of reliable core drilling power. Reinforced with a mechanical clutch and gearbox design that allows you to select between first and second gear, the EHD 2002 is completed with EIBENSTOCK's signature durable green PUR construction site power cable.

This drill is also fitted with various safety features, including a current thermal overload cut out to protect the internal components from overloading and is specifically designed for cutting through brick, blockwork & masonry; cutting a fast, clean core hole up to 6" / 152mm with ease.
The EHD 2002 S Diamond Core Drill is perfect for trade professionals needing reliability, power and accuracy and for those who find themselves coring many holes throughout their daily work schedule. Ideal for use by plumbers, gas fitters, electricians, builders and drilling and fixing contractors.

product.name: Fernox TF1 Antifreeze Valve 28mm
product.description:
The Fernox TF1 Antifreeze Valve is specifically designed to protect water-based air and ground source Heat Pump heating systems. In cold weather when temperatures drop, systems that are not treated with a glycol-based fluid can freeze within the heat pump circuit potentially causing harmful and costly damage to vulnerable heat pump components and system pipework; eventually causing premature breakdown and repair.
The Fernox TF1 Antifreeze Valve is an essential, simple to install component developed to prevent frozen systems by detecting when the fluid in the circuit is close to freezing point i.e., when the circuit temperature reaches below 3° C. The TF1 Antifreeze Valve will automatically open and release system water, preventing ice from forming within the Heat Pump system and safeguarding the operation of the system.

product.name: CalMag CalGlow 22mm Magnetic & Electrolytic Scale Inhibitor
product.description: The CalGlow Magnetic and Electrolytic Scale Inhibitor is a product designed to prevent the build up of limescale, and is suitable for cold water line installation. The CalGlow should be installed on the cold water feed of individual hot water appliances, to prevent hard scale build-up in heat exchangers, and pipework in household water systems. The unique combination of a magnetic, and electrolytic technologies allows for enhanced performance. The magnetic bar induces a single polarity into the water; this causes magnesium, and calcium particles to take on the same polarity. These particles then repel each other, causing the prevention of formation of hard limescale. On the other hand, the electrolytic bar uses zinc plates which create the same reaction as the magnetic bar. These zinc plates gradually release minute particles into the water, which prevents corrosion by abolishing all the air in the system. The CalGlow helps improve the efficiency of the system, providing you with a cleaner, highly tuned boiler, lowering fuel bills and improving maintenance costs.

product.name: Sentinel X300 Cleaner For New Systems 1L X300L-12 X 1L-Gb
product.description: Designed for new central heating systems, the Sentinel X300 cleanser flushes out flux installation debris from new indirect central heating systems. This prepares the system for the addition of an inhibitor, which will protect the system components and prolong their effective life and is essential for the prevention of sludge and scale build up. Emulsifiers in the liquid assist in the removal of grease and oils from new radiators. Dispersants lift insoluble flux, metal fillings and dust from the system. A single 1 litre bottle should be plenty to dose about 8 to 10 panels in your radiators. It can be added easily using a dosing vessel or the adaptor supplied. Ensure the system is filled before adding the X300.

product.name: Sentinel X200 Noise Reducer 1L X200L-12 X 1L-Gb
product.description: Living with a noisy boiler is not only unpleasant, but it can also be inefficient. A number of factors can cause boiler noise, but it is most often caused by a thin layer of deposit on the heat exchanger. Sentinel X200 Noise Reducer is extremely effective in solving this problem, whilst simultaneously helping to restore boiler efficiency.

product.name: Sentinel X400 High Performance Cleaner 1L X400L-12 X 1L-Gb
product.description: Specifically designed for existing systems, the Sentinel X400 High Performance Cleaner is a non-acid treatment for cleaning older heating systems, restoring circulation to radiators, and pipework. Due to it's highly efficient formula, the X400 shifts built-up magnetite sludge, and as a result eliminates cold spots in heating systems restoring heat distribution. X400 is ideal for pre-dosing as the long lasting formula can hold sludge in suspension for up to 3 week. A 1 litre bottle of X400 should be enough to dose about 8 to 10 radiator panels. It's easily added using the dosing vessel or the adaptor included. It should be circulated at normal temperature with all valves open for a minimum of two hours or until a satisfactory performance is returned. A pH neutral formula allows for use in all types of domestic heating system, including those with aluminium content.

product.name: Sentinel Leak Sealer 1L Ls-12 X 1L-Gb
product.description: This product is ideal for sealing small leaks or weeping joints on all types of indirect central heating systems. It is an easy-to-administer solution to the problem of weeping joints or pinhole leaks and it is compatible with other Sentinel products. Sentinel Leak Sealer will not cause blockages within the system.

In practical use, it convinces with its flexibility and variety of applications. Checking the gas pressure on burners by measuring gas flow pressure and static gas pressure is just as quick and precise as checking filters and Pitot tube measurement in the ventilation duct. The position-independent differential pressure sensor ensures reliable and highly accurate measurement results. The testo Smart App for smartphones and tablets supports you with these functions:
Configure measuring instrument
Display graphical measured value curve
Save measurement data
Manage customers and measuring sites
Documentation on site
E-mail dispatch of the report

To ensure that you have all the relevant information at your fingertips, the testo 416 automatically calculates time and point average values as well as the volume flow rate. product.name: Worcester Bosch Greenstar Oilfit 1M Boiler Plume Management Extension 7716190093
product.description: The Greenstar Oilfit Plume Management Extension from Worcester provides a number of different options for fluing unwanted acidic gases out of the central heating system. From an internal floor standing boiler, they can be expelled through the top, rear or side, and from the rear and side from external boilers. Quick to install, the simple push-fit connections form a gas tight seal, in most cases it will also eliminate the need to cut the flue pipe. No special tools are required when fitting flue extensions and will simply slot into place. Robust, the anti-corrosive design will provide a system that will last the life of the boiler. The extension is used when your flue system isn't quite as long as needed. Supplied with a support bracket, it creates a sturdier system with less chance of breaking down.

product.description:
UltraTile ProLevel Two is a versatile and reliable two-part smoothing underlayment designed for both commercial and domestic flooring projects. With exceptional flow characteristics, it offers ease of application and superior results on a variety of subfloors.

Key Features:

Versatile: Suitable for a wide range of flooring projects, both commercial and domestic, providing flexibility and convenience.
Ready to Receive Floor Coverings: Achieve quick turnaround times with floor coverings ready to be laid just 24 hours after application, enhancing project efficiency.
Protein-Free: Ensures compatibility with a variety of substrates, promoting reliable adhesion and long-lasting performance.
2-15mm Depth: Offers flexibility in application depth, accommodating different substrate conditions and project requirements.
Superior Flow: Exhibits excellent flow characteristics, ensuring smooth and even application for a professional finish.
Moisture Tolerant: With a moisture-tolerant formulation, it's suitable for pre-smoothing floors before the application of surface DPMs, enhancing substrate preparation and performance.
Excellent Flexibility: Provides superior flexibility, making it suitable for use with timber floors and underfloor heating systems, ensuring compatibility with various installation requirements.
Internal Use Only: Designed specifically for internal applications, providing reliability and performance in indoor environments.
Specifications:

Compressive Strength (to BS EN 13892-2):
28 Days: 31.25 N/mm²
7 Days: 22.30 N/mm²
1 Day: 8.17 N/mm²
Flexural Strength (to BS EN 13892-2):
28 Days: 10.17 N/mm²
7 Days: 4.61 N/mm²
1 Day: 2.03 N/mm²
Packaging: Available in 4-liter bottles or 20kg bags, providing options to suit different project sizes and requirements.
Working Time: Offers a working time of 20-30 minutes at 20°C, allowing for efficient application and installation.
Time to Foot Traffic: Ready for foot traffic in just 2.5 hours at 20°C, facilitating quick project progression.
Time to Cover: Can be covered after 1 day for depths up to 6mm and after 3 days for depths up to 10mm, ensuring timely completion of projects.
Application Thickness: Suitable for application thicknesses ranging from 2mm to 12mm, offering versatility and adaptability to various project needs.
Coverage: Provides approximately 4m² of coverage at a 3mm thickness, optimizing material usage and project efficiency.
Consumption/mm Thickness: Requires 1.60kg/mm/m², providing guidance for material consumption based on desired thickness.
Suitable for Pump Application: Not suitable for pump application, ensuring compatibility with manual application methods.

product.name: JG Speedfit Monobloc 15mmxM10 Flexible Hose (Braided) FLX28
product.description:
Designed by JG Speedfit, the FLX28 flexible hose connects 15mm plastic or copper pipe directly to an M10 female monobloc mixer tap. A braided stainless steel outer sleeve covers the internal feed hose to shield it against physical abrasion. Serving as an alternative to rigid copper piping, the push-fit mechanism secures without flux, glue, solder or hot works. 

Installers push the push-fit socket onto the pipe end and thread the M10 connector into the tap body. Integrated offset spanner flats on the metallic fitting allow straightforward tightening in confined under-sink spaces. Releasing the joint requires pressing the collet against the fitting body while pulling the pipe outward. JG Speedfit carries out design, manufacture and assembly of this 15mm connector within the UK.

product.name: JG Speedfit to Union Nut 1/2"x15mm Flexible Hose, 150mm Length (Braided) FLX43P
product.description: Designed and manufactured by JG Speedfit in the UK, this 150mm flexible hose links 15mm pipework to a 1/2 inch male thread fixture as an alternative to rigid piping. An outer layer of braided stainless steel shields the internal water feed from external physical damage. The 15mm push-fit end connects without flux, glue or hot works, providing a flame-free installation in confined areas. A 1/2 inch union nut on the opposing end threads directly onto the male connection of the appliance. To detach the 15mm push-fit joint, press the collet against the fitting body to release the pipe.

product.name: JG Speedfit Speedfit x Speedfit Tap Connector with Service Valve Hose 15x15mm, 300mm (Braided) FLX42
product.description:
John Guest Speedfit x Speedfit flexi hose with service valve (braided) for the connection of plastic or copper pipe. The flexi hose is ideal for the connection of two pipes where the angle is too steep to bend the pipe to make a connection. The valve enables the flow of water to be isolated in the event of an emergency or for maintenance work using a tamperproof ¼ turn screwdriver slot. Simply push the push-fit fitting fully onto the pipe. To demount the connection, push the collet towards the body of the push-fit fitting and pull the pipe release.

product.name: JG Speedfit X Speedfit With Service Valve Hose 15x15mm, 500mm (Braided) FLX45
product.description:
JG Speedfit supplies this 500mm braided flexible hose (FLX45 / FLX45P) with 15mm push-fit ends as an alternative to hard piping. Ideal for connecting taps and fixtures, the 15mm flexible hose connects lines where sharp angles prevent standard pipe bending. 

An integrated service valve features a tamperproof quarter-turn slot for a screwdriver to isolate water flow during emergency repairs or routine maintenance. The 15mm x 15mm push-fit connections allow flame-free installation without heat, solder, glue or flux. 

Simply push the 15mm connector fully onto copper or plastic piping. To disconnect, push the collet against the fitting body and release the pipe. Made and assembled in Great Britain, this 500mm hose installs quickly in confined spaces without requiring specialist tools.

product.name: Heatmiser neoStat WiFi Thermostat - Black
product.description:
The Heatmiser neoStat WiFi Thermostat is a feature-rich 230v programmable thermostat with illuminated touch keys and built-in WiFi connectivity. With its versatile functionality, the neoStat WiFi can be configured as a programmable thermostat or a timer, allowing you to take control of various devices such as towel rails or lighting in addition to your heating system.

Key Features:

WiFi Connectivity: The neoStat WiFi connects to your home broadband router, enabling remote control of your heating system from anywhere without the need for a separate hub.
Smart Home Integration: Compatible with HomeKit, Google Home, IFTTT, and Alexa, the neoStat WiFi seamlessly integrates with popular smart home ecosystems, offering enhanced control and automation options.
Enhanced History Support: The thermostat provides a 13-month history log that displays heating, preheating, and set/actual temperatures, allowing you to monitor and analyze your heating patterns.
White Backlight with Proximity Sensor: The white model of the neoStat WiFi features a white backlight with a proximity sensor, providing clear visibility and easy operation in any lighting conditions.
Backlight Dimming Function: The carbon black model of the neoStat WiFi offers a backlight dimming function, allowing you to adjust the display brightness according to your preference.
Illuminated Soft Touch Keys with Proximity Sensor: The thermostat is equipped with illuminated soft-touch keys and a proximity sensor, ensuring intuitive and effortless operation.
User Selectable Operating Modes: Choose from four operating modes - non-programmable, weekday/weekend, all days different, or all days the same - to tailor the thermostat's functionality to your specific scheduling needs.
5 Minute Program Intervals: The neoStat WiFi supports precise temperature control with 5-minute program intervals, allowing you to fine-tune your heating schedule.
0.5°C Set Temperature: Set your desired temperature with a 0.5°C precision, ensuring accurate and customized heating comfort.
Self-Learning Optimum Start: The thermostat features a self-learning optimum start function that calculates the optimal heat-up time, ensuring your home is warm and cozy when you need it.
4 Comfort Levels per Day (Option for 6 with neoApp): Enjoy up to four comfort level settings per day, providing flexibility to adjust the temperature based on your daily routine. When paired with the neoApp, you can access six comfort levels.
Temperature Hold Facility: The temperature hold feature allows you to temporarily lock the thermostat at a specific temperature, maintaining consistent heating according to your preference.
Holiday Facility: The thermostat includes a holiday function that allows you to set a specific temperature while you're away, helping you save energy without compromising comfort.
Flush Mounting: Designed for flush mounting, the neoStat WiFi seamlessly blends into your home decor for a clean and stylish appearance.
Celsius/Fahrenheit Selectable: Choose between Celsius or Fahrenheit temperature display based on your preference.
Key Code Facility: The key code facility adds an extra layer of security, allowing you to set a code to restrict access and prevent unauthorized changes to the thermostat settings.
Frost Protection: The thermostat provides frost protection to prevent freezing temperatures, ensuring the safety of your heating system.
Experience the convenience and control of the Heatmiser neoStat WiFi Thermostat. With its WiFi connectivity, versatile programming options, smart home integration, and advanced features, this thermostat offers effortless temperature control for optimal comfort and energy efficiency in your home.

Dimensions (L,H,D)	85x85x15mm
Temperature Range	05-45°C
No. Heating Levels	4Max
Current	Volt Free 3A
Optional Probe (not included)	Floor sensor or Room Sensor
Probe Rating	10Kohm, 12Kohm, 15Kohm NTC
IP Rating	IP20

product.name: Vaillant EcoTec Plus 836 36kW Combi Boiler 0010036017
product.description:
Vaillant engineered this 36kW combination boiler under code 0010036017 for residential heating networks. The unit connects to the plug-and-play myVAILLANT connect internet gateway to enable app connectivity, supporting most Vaillant controls while excluding the timeSWITCH 150 and timeSWITCH 160 timers. 

A semi-touch digital interface features a step-by-step commissioning wizard for setup. Identical case dimensions, footprint dimensions, flue positioning and pipe connections ensure a direct like-for-like swap with previous generation models. A refined internal layout provides front access to all main internal components during routine servicing. 

Integrated IoniDetect technology continually analyses gas quality to adjust combustion automatically, permitting LPG site conversion during setup without supplementary components. Gas type adaptation is available across the range, with exceptions for the 840, 940 and 635 ecoTEC plus variants.

Fitting comfortably inside a cupboard with ease due to a compact 283mm depth, this energy-saving boiler boasts the same high-quality construction as the NCB700.

The boiler also features a built-in, text-driven digital display panel; simple to program and use, it includes a two-channel timer and allows energy usage to be monitored with ease. product.description:
This Hansgrohe thermostatic shower system in a stylish matt black finish brings an exceptional level of luxury and reliability to your daily bathroom routine. Designed to offer a welcoming sense of comfort, this modern fixture combines water efficiency with an invigorating performance.

The hand shower features two distinct spray patterns to match your mood, allowing you to choose between a gentle, activating rain spray and a focused, massaging impact spray. Swapping between these different modes is incredibly simple, requiring just the quick press of a button. To help look after the environment and reduce your utility bills, the system is designed with clever technology that limits water flow to a maximum of eight litres per minute. Even with this reduced consumption, the dynamically adapting flexible jets ensure you always experience a powerful and satisfying spray.

For your peace of mind and safety, the integrated thermostatic mixer maintains a constant water temperature, preventing sudden cold or hot spikes. The system is designed for exposed wall installation, meaning it can be fitted easily without the need to cut into your bathroom walls. It comes complete with a high-quality slide rail featuring an adjustable holder that can be easily positioned with one hand, giving you total flexibility. Cleaning is also effortless, as the pliable silicone nozzles are specifically designed so that you can simply wipe away limescale deposits. With a special hose connection that prevents tangles and a generous five-year manufacturer guarantee, this shower system represents a beautiful, long-term upgrade for your home.

EIBENSTOCK PLD 182.1 Professional 2300W Heavy Duty Wet & Dry Diamond Core Drill

It prevents sudden jerks or damage caused by jamming, ensuring safer operation and extending the tool's lifespan by minimising strain on the motor. Additionally, a high-quality PUR (polyurethane) power cable is attached to the drill, which is highly durable and resistant to abrasion, chemicals, and wear. This ensures long-lasting reliability, even in demanding construction environments.

product.name: EIBENSTOCK ESD 162 Professional 2200W Heavy Duty Soft Percussion Dry Diamond Core Drill with Carry Case 240V 4704062
product.description:
EIBENSTOCK ESD 162 Professional 2200W Heavy Duty Soft Percussion Dry Diamond Core Drill
EIBENSTOCK ESD 162 Professional 2200W Heavy Duty Soft Percussion Dry Diamond Core Drill is expertly designed for dry drilling through the toughest materials, including reinforced concrete and stone. Ideal for environments where wet drilling isn't an option, this drill leverages EIBENSTOCK's innovative Impact Hybrid Technology (IHT) and utilises a dual thread spindle of 1¼" UNC male & ½" BSP female for pairing the correct high quality diamond cores.
The precision-engineered toothed ring geometry in the IHT system delivers high-frequency impacts, ensuring faster drilling in hard materials when paired with our specialised IHT-compatible diamond core bits. The ESD 162 diamond drill is ideal for drilling through hard building materials in areas where wet drilling with a water feed is not an option, such as electrical rooms, clinical environments, and hospitals.
The ESD 162 is equipped with the EDMC Pro digital motor control system, which includes service and overload indicators. This advanced system monitors the drill's performance in real time, ensuring optimal operation while protecting the motor from overload and enhancing its longevity.
For increased stability and control, the ESD 162 can be mounted on a rig, making it suitable for larger and more demanding jobs. Additionally, when paired with an anti-vibration BST 162 H drill rig, it can handle cores up to 162mm, providing professional-grade precision and reduced operator fatigue during extended drilling tasks.
To ensure a cleaner and safer work environment, the ESD 162 features a dust extraction swivel that significantly reduces airborne dust. This not only helps maintain air quality on-site but also extends the life of the diamond segments by reducing wear caused by dust buildup.

JG Speedfit manufactures this white cross-linked polyethylene barrier pipe in a 15mm diameter by 3m length. Constructed with five distinct layers, the pipe features a blue oxygen barrier in the centre layer to stop air entering and protect metal components from corrosion.

product.description:
JG Speedfit manufactures this 15mm x 100m polybutylene plastic pipe coil in a clean white finish for central heating systems. The 5-layer polybutylene material incorporates a coloured oxygen barrier at its centre to stop air entering the system and corroding metal components. Engineered to lay flat straight from the 100m coil, the flexible plastic does not recoil, which makes cabling through floor joists and completing long pipe runs simpler.

This flexible polybutylene construction cuts down on necessary fittings compared to standard rigid copper systems to reduce installation labour and material expenses. Manufactured to standard UK plumbing dimensions, this 15mm white pipe minimises material waste during installation. 

This JG Speedfit pipe coil is fully kite marked to British Standard BS7291 Parts 2 and Class S, alongside complete WRAS approval. Designed, produced and assembled within the UK, it offers higher flexibility than standard PEX or polybutylene piping.

When removed from the coil, the pipe lays flat and stays flat meaning there are no issues with the pipe retaining its memory and trying to coil back into place. product.name: ProWarm Foil Underfloor Heating Mat (Wood, Vinyl & Carpet) - 10.0 M2
product.description:
Introducing the ProWarm Foil Underfloor Heating Mat - the perfect solution for those seeking a comfortable and efficient way to heat their wooden, vinyl, and carpet floors. This innovative product is designed to provide consistent and controllable warmth throughout any wooden flooring, from engineered boards to laminate and hardwood, as well as for vinyl or carpet floors.

The ProWarm Foil Underfloor Heating Mat is easy to install and is compatible with most types of floating floors, ensuring a quick and hassle-free installation process. It features a high-quality heating foil that provides reliable and even heat distribution throughout any floor.

Backed by an industry-leading lifetime warranty, the ProWarm Foil Underfloor Heating Mat provides peace of mind, ensuring you can enjoy the benefits of underfloor heating for years to come. Upgrade your home's heating system with the ProWarm Wood Underfloor Heating Mat and experience the ultimate in comfort and energy efficiency today.

Installation Requirements
These mats MUST be installed in conjunction with ProFoam or XPS Insulation.
When installing carpet/vinyl flooring, Heat-Pak Dual Overlay must also be used.
Ensure that the carpet and underlay combined tog value does not exceed 2.0. Note that in most cases, when carpet is laid, underfloor heating cannot be used as a primary heat source.
Kit Contents
ProWarm Foil Underfloor Heating Mat: Available in single, double, or triple mat configurations for areas over 12m2.
Digital Thermostat: Take control of your comfort with our range of programmable digital thermostats, each equipped with a floor temperature probe.
Adhesive Tape: Ensures a secure installation, keeping the mat or cable in place for a flawless finish.
Conduit: Adds an extra layer of durability and reliability to your heating system.
Specifications
The ProWarm Foil system is an ultra-thin electric radiant floor heating system primarily for use under laminate, engineered wood, glued hardwood, and other floating floors.
Made with Fluoropolymer insulated heating cables sandwiched between two layers of specially reinforced aluminum foil.
Uniform spacing of the heating elements ensures even heat distribution.
Available in heat outputs of 150 W/m2.
Hot and Cold lead junctions are uniquely designed for foolproof installation.
Meets all test requirements of IEC 60335 and SEMKO certified.
Cost-effective, flexible, and easy to install.
Provides close and uniform spacing of heating cables for higher comfort.
Wide range of heat loads and sizes ensure suitability to all kinds of floorings.

product.name: ProWarm Foil Underfloor Heating Mat (Wood, Vinyl & Carpet) - 7.0 M2
product.description:
Introducing the ProWarm Foil Underfloor Heating Mat - the perfect solution for those seeking a comfortable and efficient way to heat their wooden, vinyl, and carpet floors. This innovative product is designed to provide consistent and controllable warmth throughout any wooden flooring, from engineered boards to laminate and hardwood, as well as for vinyl or carpet floors.

The ProWarm Foil Underfloor Heating Mat is easy to install and is compatible with most types of floating floors, ensuring a quick and hassle-free installation process. It features a high-quality heating foil that provides reliable and even heat distribution throughout any floor.

Backed by an industry-leading lifetime warranty, the ProWarm Foil Underfloor Heating Mat provides peace of mind, ensuring you can enjoy the benefits of underfloor heating for years to come. Upgrade your home's heating system with the ProWarm Wood Underfloor Heating Mat and experience the ultimate in comfort and energy efficiency today.

Installation Requirements
These mats MUST be installed in conjunction with ProFoam or XPS Insulation.
When installing carpet/vinyl flooring, Heat-Pak Dual Overlay must also be used.
Ensure that the carpet and underlay combined tog value does not exceed 2.0. Note that in most cases, when carpet is laid, underfloor heating cannot be used as a primary heat source.
Kit Contents
ProWarm Foil Underfloor Heating Mat: Available in single, double, or triple mat configurations for areas over 12m2.
Digital Thermostat: Take control of your comfort with our range of programmable digital thermostats, each equipped with a floor temperature probe.
Adhesive Tape: Ensures a secure installation, keeping the mat or cable in place for a flawless finish.
Conduit: Adds an extra layer of durability and reliability to your heating system.
Specifications
The ProWarm Foil system is an ultra-thin electric radiant floor heating system primarily for use under laminate, engineered wood, glued hardwood, and other floating floors.
Made with Fluoropolymer insulated heating cables sandwiched between two layers of specially reinforced aluminum foil.
Uniform spacing of the heating elements ensures even heat distribution.
Available in heat outputs of 150 W/m2.
Hot and Cold lead junctions are uniquely designed for foolproof installation.
Meets all test requirements of IEC 60335 and SEMKO certified.
Cost-effective, flexible, and easy to install.
Provides close and uniform spacing of heating cables for higher comfort.
Wide range of heat loads and sizes ensure suitability to all kinds of floorings.
